title: Rustfri Smed
description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

title: Farmakonom til indkøbsfunktionen, Regionsapoteket Midtjylland
description:
Vil du arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem lægemidler, data og forsyningssikkerhed? 

Så har du chancen, da vi søger en ny kollega til en fast stilling i indkøbsfunktionen

Du bliver en del af en funktion med 15 dygtige og engagerede kollegaer. Vi varetager regionens samlede indkøb af lægemidler og har desuden en stor opgave i at levere data til regionens andre systemer vedr. lægemidler. Vi er til stadighed optaget af at sætte patienten i centrum ved at optimere vores sortiment, opretholde en høj grad af forsyningssikkerhed, bruge vores faglighed på tværs i organisationen, være gode og interagerende kollegaer og ved at udvise den nødvendige omhyggelighed i forhold til økonomi.

Dine opgaver bliver bl.a.:

  • Indkøbsrelaterede opgaver: F.eks. indkøbsordrer, elektronisk varemodtagelse, behandling af restordrer.
  • Lagerstyring
  • Kvalitetsopgaver jf. GDP lovgivningen
  • Opdatering og vedligehold af lægemiddelstamdata
  • Samarbejde med interne og eksterne interessenter

Vi forventer, at du

  • er uddannet farmakonom.
  • kan kommunikere på dansk på tværs i organisationen (mundtligt og skriftligt) med venlighed og evne til at se et behov fra flere vinkler
  • er serviceminded, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst
  • er en positiv og engageret kollega, der naturligt bidrager til fælles opgaveløsning og et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • er kvalitetsbevidst, struktureret og har blik for detaljen
  • har stor interesse for lægemiddeldata og stamdata og et godt blik for værdien heraf
  • har interesse for lagerstyring
  • er nysgerrig og elsker at lære nyt, og bidrager dermed til funktionens udvikling
  • er god til at skabe et overblik over sammenhænge i arbejdsgange
  • har et personligt drive, der gør dig i stand til at være med til at forme din egen hverdag

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling, og hvor vores værdier om dialog, dygtighed, dristighed og vores strategiske ambition om at være en lærende og attraktiv arbejdsplads er i centrum
  • Engagerede og kompetente kollegaer i et godt arbejdsmiljø med både selvstændighed og fælles opgaveløsning
  • Tæt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper og organisatoriske enheder
  • Oplæring og uddannelse i opgaverne f.eks. indenfor GDP lovgivning, datahåndtering og supply chain management

Indkøbsfunktionen er en del af apotekets område for lægemiddelforsyning, og vi indkøber årligt lægemidler for over 2 milliarder kr. Størsteparten indkøbes via fælles nationale udbud. Funktionens mangeartede opgaver varetages i et tæt samarbejde mellem alle faggrupper både internt i funktionen og generelt på Regionsapoteket, ligesom der er en tæt kontakt til leverandører, grossister, Amgros, Lægemiddelstyrelsen og de øvrige regioners hospitalsapoteker.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår 

Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst mellem din faglige organisation og Danske Regioner. 

Du vil blive ansat i en fast stilling i 37 timer/uge med forventet ansættelse pr. 1. februar 2027

Regionsapotekets indkøbsfunktion er fysisk placeret på adressen: Palle Juul-Jensens Boulevard 240, 8200 Aarhus N

Yderligere oplysninger 

Hvis du ønsker flere oplysninger om stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte farmakonom, koordinator Bente Kjær tlf. 2365 2815 eller Funktionsleder Rikke Gulddal tlf. 2176 2841

Ansøgningsfrist

Send os meget gerne en kort motiveret ansøgning sammen med relevante bilag

senest mandag den 23. november 2026

Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler i uge 49.

Regionsapoteket Midtjylland er en tværgående fællesfunktion i Region Midtjylland med ca. 450 ansatte og en samlet omsætning på ca. 2,7 mia. kroner. Regionsapoteket spiller en afgørende rolle i at sikre sammenhæng og kvalitet i borgernes medicinske behandling gennem lægemiddelforsyning, klinisk farmaci og farmaceutisk rådgivning til hospitaler og sundhedsvæsenet i det nære.  Læs mere om Regionsapoteket HER. 

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt en fuldtidsstilling.Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Warehouse Specialist
description:
About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

Department: Talgo Warranty / Logistics & Warehouse Operations

Position Summary: The Warehouse Specialist is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, movement, control, and distribution of materials supporting Talgo warranty operations. The role ensures stock accuracy, timely material availability, safe warehouse practices, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Update and consult information related to incoming and outgoing materials using the designated software application (SW tool).

  • Analyze, plan, and organize material flow and delivery to assembly workstations in coordination with senior management.

  • Monitor and follow up on internally manufactured materials throughout the production flow while maintaining effective communication with all involved departments.

  • Ensure proper management and replenishment of all KANBAN materials.

  • Detect data discrepancies and report errors or inconsistencies to senior management.

  • Move materials using appropriate lifting, handling, and internal transportation equipment.

  • Conduct inventory counts and support stock accuracy initiatives.

  • Follow up and claim required materials from procurement, purchasing, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders, providing status updates to management.

  • Manage warehouse stock including receiving, storing, counting goods, monitoring shelf life where applicable, and handling expired or rejected items.

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers, ensuring smooth communication and service levels.

  • Operate outdoor vehicles such as vans, trucks, and cars to support operational requirements and resolve logistics issues.

  • Ensure correct receipt, storage, distribution, and internal logistics operations to provide workstations with required materials on time.

  • Pack and palletize all incoming and outgoing materials in accordance with company procedures, quality requirements, and safety guidelines.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience in warehouse, logistics, material control, or a similar role.

  • Ability to use warehouse management and inventory software systems.

  • Knowledge of stock control, inventory management, and material handling processes.

  • Strong organizational, planning, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work safely, accurately, and effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good teamwork and problem-solving capabilities.

employer: Slagteren og Kokken i Gistrup ApS
description:
Slagteren & Kokken i Gistrup Aps.

Vi er en slagterbutik med en stor catringafdeling, hvor vi laver et bredt udvalg af hjemmelavet specialiteter. Alt fra det traditionelle til det mere nytænkende og bæredygtige.

Claus Jensen har drevet Slagteren & Kokken i Gistrup i 21 år, for 2 år siden købte Steffen Werge sig ind i butikken og vi er igang med et generationsskifte, hvor Steffen overtager butikken 100% om 3 år.

Vi uddanner elever både Gourmetslagter og Cater/smørrebrød.

Slagteren & Kokken søger en ny medarbejder. Måske er du uddannet Kok, Cater/smørrebrød, eller Gourmetslagter/delikatesse, det vigtigste er at du har passion og glæde ved at lave dejlig mad til vores kunder.

Vi søger en person der kan gå ind og tage ansvaret for den varme del af vores catringafdeling. Det bliver i samarbejde med 3 andre ansatte. Du skal også være indstillet på at være med til at oplære/undervise vores elever.

Det bliver en meget afvekslende arbejds dag, hvor vi laver dagens middag ( traditionel dansk køkken ) færdigretter, supper, saucer, den varme del af vores catring og meget mere, vi er altid åben for nye tiltag.

Vi søger en person til en fast stilling og som vil være med til at udvikle vores catringafdeling og skabe en stabil, rar og bæredygtig hverdag.

Vi sætter stor pris på åbenhed og imødekommenhed, høj service for vores dejlige kunder, stor ansvarsbevisthed for de produkter vi servere. Vi laver alt selv fra bunden. Vi håber på at du er klar på at arbejde sammen med dine kollegaer og da vi er en "lille" butik så hjælper vi altid hinanden og derfor bliver der også kundebetjening i din hverdag, men det primær arbejde bliver i det kolde køkken. Hvis du får brug for hjælp, er der altid nogle der stå klar til at give en hånd med, så vi altid når at blive færdig til tiden.

Vi kan tilbyde rigtige gode arbejds tider.

description:
Please see English version below.

Om Talgo

Talgo er en førende international togproducent og leverandør af vedligeholdelsestjenester med mere end 75 års erfaring inden for innovation i jernbanesektoren.

Stillingen

Vi søger en engageret og teknisk dygtig Warranty Elektriker til vores team i Næstved. Du bliver en del af vores warranty-afdeling, hvor du vil arbejde med fejlfinding, diagnosticering, reparation og teknisk support af tog under garantiperioden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udføre montage, demontering, målinger, fejlsøgning og korrigerende vedligeholdelse på elektriske og elektroniske systemer i tog.

  • Udskifte og reparere elektriske og elektroniske komponenter.

  • Gennemføre og dokumentere ændringer baseret på analyser af tilbagevendende fejl.

  • Overvåge og følge op på togssystemers funktion og ydeevne.

  • Anvende diagnoseværktøjer, software og interfaces til dataindsamling og fejlfinding.

  • Yde teknisk support og samarbejde tæt med Product Maintenance-teamet.

  • Udarbejde tekniske rapporter og dokumentation.

  • Sikre overholdelse af sikkerheds-, kvalitets- og driftsstandarder.

  • Bidrage til root cause-analyser og løbende forbedringsinitiativer.

Din profil

  • Uddannet elektriker, el-tekniker eller tilsvarende.

  • Erfaring med elektrisk vedligeholdelse og fejlfinding.

  • Evne til at læse og forstå el-diagrammer og teknisk dokumentation.

  • Gode engelskkundskaber i skrift og tale.

  • Struktureret, kvalitetsbevidst og teamorienteret.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Faglige og personlige udviklingsmuligheder.

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Arbejde med moderne og innovativ jernbaneteknologi.

///

About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

The Role

Join our warranty team delivering troubleshooting, repairs, diagnostics and technical support for train electrical and electronic systems during the warranty period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform assembly, disassembly, measurement, diagnosis, corrective maintenance, and follow-up of electrical/electronic failures in the various train systems.

  • Change and replace any type of electrical and electronic element and component of the train.

  • Carry out and report modifications resulting from the analysis of systematic electrical/electronic failure reports.

  • Track, accompany, and supervise train systems and their performance.

  • Load and extract data from diagnostic software, interfaces, and electrical/electronic system tools.

  • Collaborate with Product Maintenance teams to provide troubleshooting support and technical advice.

  • Prepare technical reports and documentation of interventions and corrective actions performed.

  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards.

  • Support root-cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives.

Requirements

  • Electrical Technician, Electrician, or similar qualification.

  • Experience in electrical maintenance and troubleshooting.

  • Ability to read electrical diagrams and technical documentation.

  • English required.

What We Offer

  • International environment

  • Development opportunities

  • Competitive conditions

  • Work with modern railway technology

title: Truckfører til fuldtidsvikariat på Imercos aftenhold
description:
Vi søger en truckfører til Imercos Facility-team hos Imerco. Du får en vigtig rolle i den daglige drift omkring de 45 AutoStore-robotter og bliver samtidig en del af det team, der sikrer, at lageret holdes kørende og ryddeligt.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at sikre, at AutoStore-anlægget kan køre stabilt og effektivt.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Have ansvar for løbende batteriskift på de 45 AutoStore-robotter

  • Holde øje med robotterne og reagere, hvis noget ikke fungerer som det skal

  • Bruge din tekniske forståelse til at identificere og håndtere mindre driftsmæssige udfordringer omkring AutoStore

  • Køre almindelig gaffeltruck som en del af dine daglige opgaver

  • Når AutoStore kører stabilt, indgå som paptømmer på Facility-teamet

  • Sørge for, at gulvpladsen holdes fri for pap, affald og tom emballage

Du får altså en varieret hverdag, hvor du både arbejder med truck, teknik og de praktiske opgaver, der får lageret til at fungere.

Du får en grundig introduktion og oplæring snarest muligt, så du lærer både arbejdsgangene, trucken og AutoStore-systemet at kende.

Herefter er der tale om fuldtidsarbejde fra 16. november til 4. januar, hvor vi har ekstra travlt på grund af julehandlen. Når julehandlen for alvor går i gang, er der ekstra tryk på lageret, og derfor skal du være indstillet på at arbejde weekender som en del af Facility-teamet.

Du skal have en god teknisk forståelse og flair for elektronik, da du kommer til at arbejde tæt på AutoStore-robotterne. Du behøver ikke være robottekniker, men du skal være nysgerrig på teknikken, kunne forstå sammenhænge og have lyst til at lære systemet at kende.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har gyldigt truckcertifikat og erfaring med gaffeltruck

  • Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for elektronik og automatiserede systemer

  • Er god til at bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar

  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke er bange for at tage fat

  • Trives med en varieret hverdag, hvor opgaverne kan ændre sig

  • Er en holdspiller, der hjælper til, når der er behov

Har du erfaring med AutoStore eller andre automatiserede lagerløsninger, er det en klar fordel – men det vigtigste er din tekniske nysgerrighed og lyst til at lære.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

title: Servicekoordinatorer/Supervisor søges til hoteller
description:
2 stillinger som servicekoordinator/supervisor 37 timer pr. uge med start hurtigst muligt.

Hos Suveren er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Vi ønsker at tiltrække og tilbyde vores kunder de bedste medarbejdere i branchen. I Suverens Service Academy giver vi dig den nødvendige uddannelse og træning for at du kan leve op til vores og kundernes forventninger. Har du et brændende ønske om at skabe karriere, så er mulighederne tilstede.

Hos os får du ansvar fra dag et og vil efterhånden blive koblet på serviceopgaver, hvor du sammen med dygtige kolleger skaber kundeoplevelser med sans for detajlen.

Har du lyst til at være en del af en virksomhed i udvikling, og brænder du for at gøre en forskel inden for Hotel & Restauration, så tøv ikke med at kontakte os.

ARBEJDSOPGAVER

  • Planlægning og godkendelse af timeregistreringer

  • Kvalitetskontrol

  • Daglige ledelse og koordinering

KVALIFIKATIONER

  • Koordinering af opgaver og aftaler

  • Kundeservice og relationsopbygning

  • Evne til at prioritere og overholde deadlines

title: Anesthesia nurse are sought for Anesthesia Department 2
description: We are looking for anesthesia nurses who wish to work in a department that provides anesthesia for cardiac, pulmonary, vascular, and gastrointestinal surgery patients. You will become part of a dedicated and interdisciplinary team that values high professional standards, education, and good cooperation.Anesthesia Department 2We are organized into two specialty-based teams, with a focus on maintaining specialty-specific competencies while also helping one another across teams to create flexibility and variety in everyday work. We are looking for colleagues who are interested in both teams, but please mention any preference in your application.Team A:Handles anesthesia for abdominal surgery, ECT treatment, and interventional procedures (e.g., PTC and Coiling). The team also contributes to internal and external transfers and operates the IV team, specializing in advanced invasive access.Team TV:A highly specialized team providing anesthesia for cardiac, thoracic, and vascular surgery, as well as procedures in the cardiology catheterization laboratory, the pulmonary medicine outpatient clinic, and the radiology department. We receive emergency cardiac patients from the pre-hospital team, are part of the hospital's cardiac arrest team, and provide anesthesiology support in response to emergency calls within the hospital.Anesthesia Department 2 is a training site for nursing students, nurse anesthesia trainees, physicians in specialist training, and paramedics. During on-call shifts, we are responsible for the same clinical specialties as during daytime hours, but we also work as part of a broad cross-team on-call group. We support one another to ensure that the overall anesthesia workload in the operating suite runs smoothly for the benefit of patients. Regardless of patient category, we focus on maintaining a professional and compassionate nursing relationship with each patient. We would like to hear what, in your view, characterizes a good patient journey.We are looking for a colleague who...Already has or can obtain a Danish Authorization in accordance with Danish lawIs fluent in Danish, Norwegian or Swedish (preferably)  has a specialized education in anesthesia nursingthrives with both highly specialized and general anesthesia nursinghas a positive, flexible, and professional approach to changevalues professional quality and individual care for the patientcontributes actively to good cooperation and a healthy work environmentis eager to participate in our educational tasksWith us, you will receive...a thorough and individually tailored introduction programSupport from experienced colleagues, with a focus on both professional and social integrationAn exciting working environment with a high level of specialization and opportunities for professional discussion and peer supportA strong emphasis on education, development, and interdisciplinary collaborationGreat colleagues and room for individual differencesLanguage practice with an in-house consultant Working hours and planningDay shift: 7:30 a.m.- 3:15 p.m. (late shifts until 4:15 p.m., 5:15 p.m., and 6:15 p.m.)Evening/night shift: Four staff members start at 2:45 p.m. and work actively until 10:45 p.m., followed by an on-call shift from the staff on-call room until 7:30 a.m.We work with a 16-week rota cycle. Scheduling is carried out in close collaboration between the rota planner and clinical coordinators. Individual preferences are given high priority within the needs of the team and the requirements of the service.This year, we moved into new, modern facilities in Hospitalsbyen and are currently adapting to the new workflows. In addition, we currently have one abdominal surgery operating list per week at Aalborg Hospital South on Hobrovej.If you are passionate about anesthesia, professional excellence, and meaningful patient journeys, we look forward to hearing from you. Questions?For any questions regarding the position please contact Head Nurse Manager Merete Isaksen Dietz by phone on +45 30 56 75 32 or by e-mail at mli@rn.dk.For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm - m.cederstroem@rn.dk Practical informationSalary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Confederation's area, concluded with the Danish Nurses' Organization. The position is 37 hours per week.The application deadline is 31. december 2026, and interviews are expected to take place in january. The preferred start date is 1 of february 2027, or by agreement.Place of workYour primary place of employment will be Anesthesia Department 2 in Aalborg. Your employment area is the North Denmark Region, with duties at Aalborg University Hospital, Anesthesia Aalborg. You may also be required to work in other departments within Anesthesia Aalborg, subject to the notice period for changes to the rota specified in the collective agreement.References will be obtained before an employment offer is made.About the North Denmark RegionThe North Denmark Region provides welfare services to approximately 590,000 people in North Jutland in the areas of healthcare, regional development, and specialized social services. Around 15,000 employees work together on this mission, bringing a wide range of professional expertise to create value every day for patients and citizens in North Jutland and to support a cohesive region. With us, you can build your career, make every day count, and make a difference. Read more about the region at www.rn.dk.

title: CNC Machinist at MC Uldall – Work with Advanced CNC Turning in Stainless Steel
description:
CNC Machinist – Advanced Turning of Stainless Steel

No application or CV required - Danish optional!

Would you like to work with complex components, modern Okuma machines and a high degree of freedom in your daily work?

At MC Uldall Maskinfabrik, we are looking for a skilled CNC machinist to join our turning department in Skanderborg, Denmark.

We manufacture high-precision components for industries including food processing, pharmaceuticals and offshore. Our customers have high expectations when it comes to quality, documentation and surface finish. We are therefore looking for a colleague who takes pride in their craftsmanship and enjoys finding the right technical solutions.

What we offer

  • A strong team of experienced CNC machinists and machine operators

  • Modern Okuma machines and exciting technical challenges

  • Flexible working hours, with start times between 5:30 and 8:00 a.m.

  • Opportunities for professional development and responsibility

  • A flat organisational structure where your ideas are heard

  • A financially sound and growing company

  • A good canteen arrangement and a great team atmosphere

Your responsibilities

You will be working with:

  • Setting up and machining stainless steel components

  • Programming and optimisation using IGF and Mastercam

  • Operating Okuma LB4000EX II, LT200MY and Multus U4000 machines

  • Ongoing quality control and documentation

  • Optimising machining processes and cycle times

We work with both one-off and small-batch production, offering a varied working day with a wide range of components and technical challenges.

What we expect from you

  • You are a qualified CNC machinist, industrial technician or have equivalent qualifications

  • You have experience in CNC turning

  • Experience with Okuma machines and/or Mastercam is an advantage

  • You work independently and take responsibility for quality

  • You are organised and contribute to a positive team environment within the department

Above all, what matters is that you want to be part of the team and are passionate about your trade.

Who is MC Uldall?

MC Uldall Maskinfabrik A/S is a modern subcontract manufacturing company with more than 50 employees based in Skanderborg, Denmark. We specialise in machining and welding stainless steel and supply components to some of Northern Europe's most demanding industries.

We combine a high level of technical expertise with a down-to-earth culture where we support one another and take good care of our employees.

Neither an application nor a CV is required. Save yourself the time and simply answer a few questions, and we will get in touch for an informal conversation.

title: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  #LI-CL1

title: Warehouse Specialist
description:
About Talgo

Talgo is a leading international train manufacturer and maintenance provider with more than 75 years of experience in railway innovation.

Department: Talgo Warranty / Logistics & Warehouse Operations

Position Summary: The Warehouse Specialist is responsible for the efficient receipt, storage, movement, control, and distribution of materials supporting Talgo warranty operations. The role ensures stock accuracy, timely material availability, safe warehouse practices, and effective communication with internal stakeholders, suppliers, and customers.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Update and consult information related to incoming and outgoing materials using the designated software application (SW tool).

  • Analyze, plan, and organize material flow and delivery to assembly workstations in coordination with senior management.

  • Monitor and follow up on internally manufactured materials throughout the production flow while maintaining effective communication with all involved departments.

  • Ensure proper management and replenishment of all KANBAN materials.

  • Detect data discrepancies and report errors or inconsistencies to senior management.

  • Move materials using appropriate lifting, handling, and internal transportation equipment.

  • Conduct inventory counts and support stock accuracy initiatives.

  • Follow up and claim required materials from procurement, purchasing, suppliers, and other relevant stakeholders, providing status updates to management.

  • Manage warehouse stock including receiving, storing, counting goods, monitoring shelf life where applicable, and handling expired or rejected items.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 9, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment termsAppointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.
