title: Restaurant Manager
description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description - Restaurant Manager –Indian Dining Experience

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Restaurant Manager to take full ownership of our service. If you have a passion for authentic Indian cuisine and the drive to build a high-performance culture, we will look forward to welcome you to lead our team.

This is not a back-office role. We are looking for a visible leader who thrives on the floor, inspires the team, and ensures every guest leaves with a memorable experience.

Responsibilities:

Service ownership: Take complete charge of the dining room, ensuring service personnel are attentive, aligned, and delivering our high-quality service standards.

Team Leadership: Build a high-performance culture through hands-on training, onboarding, and continuous development of the service team.

Guest Experience: Actively engage with diners, capture valuable feedback, and guarantee ultimate guest satisfaction.

Operations & Standards: Hands-on maintenance of high-quality hygiene and take full control of FOH supplies, inventory, and stock.

Digital Presence: Manage our social media channels to showcase our vibrant dishes, culture, and events.

Who We Are Looking For:

· Experience: 3–4 years of proven leadership experience in the hospitality industry is essential.

· Cuisine Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian cuisine is essential; prior management experience in an Indian restaurant is highly preferred.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

· Personality & Presence: Outgoing, hardworking, and naturally hospitable. You bring a "service with a smile" mentality and project a welcoming, highly professional presence on the floor.

· Bonus Skills: Hands-on experience with beverage pairing, craft cocktails, and premium coffee making will give you a significant advantage.

What We Offer:

· A highly competitive salary.

· Autonomy to shape the service culture and FOH operations.

· A vibrant, fast-paced work environment with a passionate team.

· Opportunities for long-term career growth.

Ready to lead our service?

Please send your CV (including a professional headshot) and a cover letter describing your experience and motivation to info@tandooritwist.dk.

title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

title: Junior Finance Controller
description:
Kick-start your finance career in a growing international technology company.

As our new Junior Finance Controller, you will gain hands-on experience with finance operations, SAP processes, and financial controls while working closely with experienced colleagues in an innovative and globally expanding organization.

Based at our headquarters in Kongens Lyngby, Denmark, you will join the Finance Operations team and report to the Head of Finance Operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for an early-career finance professional to develop both technical finance expertise and business understanding in a high-tech international environment. The role supports our continued growth and integration within the Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation group.

You will be part of an ambitious company where we win together. Team spirit and mutual success are key components in our everyday work culture.

Tasks and responsibilities

Support Finance OperationsSupport daily SAP Finance activities, including transaction processing, master data validation, and basic troubleshooting to ensure efficient finance operations.

Manage Invoice Processing

Help ensure incoming invoices are processed accurately and on time while maintaining high standards of financial control and compliance.

Maintain Process Documentation

Prepare, update, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other finance process documentation in line with group standards and best practices.

Contribute to Continuous Improvement

Support the standardization and continuous improvement of finance processes and frameworks across the organization.

Support Month-End Closing

Assist with journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation as part of the monthly financial closing process.

Participate in Ad Hoc Projects

Contribute to various finance and administrative projects and tasks as required by the team.

Skills, experiences and qualifications we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 1-2 years of relevant experience within finance, accounting, or a similar function.
  • Understanding of fundamental accounting principles and financial processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to work.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop professionally.
  • Experience working with SAP FI or another ERP system.
  • Exposure to process documentation and SOP development.
  • Experience from an international company or shared service environment.

Questions You are welcome to reach out to hiring manager: Michael Forster, Head of Finance Operations, mifo@nilt.com

Interested?

Please forward your CV and application letter incl. answers to the 2 questions below, no later than 23 November 2026. We look forward to hearing from you.

1. Key experience #1

ERP Systems

Please describe your experience with SAP or other ERP systems. What tasks have you performed, and what did you learn from the experience?

2. Key experience #2

Accounting and Financial Processes

Please provide an example of a finance or accounting task you have handled where attention to detail was particularly important. What was your role and what was the outcome?

About NIL Technology

NIL Technology (NILT), founded in 2006, is an optical solutions company designing, developing, and manufacturing optical elements and components using high-precision nanoscale features. NILT creates competitive advantages with flat optics (meta-optics) in optical applications for 3D sensing, consumer electronics, machine vision, autonomous vehicles, telecommunication, and AR. With its background in mastering and nanoimprint, the company produces masters and offers nano-foundry services. NILT is based in Denmark and has offices in Switzerland, Sweden, Finland, US, and a manufacturing in Malaysia. NILT is owned by Radiant Opto-Electronics Corporation (www.radiant.com.tw).

Visit us at www.nilt.com.).

title: High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor
description:
Role Overview

The High School Psychologist / Social-Emotional Counsellor is a member of the Student Support Team and shares responsibility for student wellbeing, inclusion and mental health across the High School. The role provides direct counselling, psychological support, consultation, and system-level guidance to students, families and staff, with particular attention to students who are socially, emotionally or psychologically vulnerable. Working hours and days are flexible and can be arranged to fit your existing schedule. You have the freedom to allocate your working hours across the week in a way that suits your availability while meeting the needs of students and the school.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide individual social-emotional counselling to students aged 15–19, supporting their mental health, resilience, relationships and academic wellbeing.

Do you have solid experience in welding and tack welding, and do you thrive in a structured environment with clear expectations and a strong focus on quality and precision? You will become part of a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company with a strong focus on quality, safety, and responsible production. You will join a team manufacturing load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. The work is carried out on the weekend day shift, where you will follow established work procedures and contribute to ensuring tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and to a high standard of quality.

Your working hours will be from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Tack welding and welding steel structures based on technical drawings and work instructions

  • Carrying out tasks with a systematic and thorough approach
  • Contributing to strong teamwork with colleagues in production
  • Complying with all applicable safety, quality, and documentation requirements

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for an experienced and reliable employee who works in a structured and detail-oriented manner. You thrive in a well-defined environment, can maintain an overview in a busy production setting, and take pride in delivering lasting, high-quality results.

We expect that you:

  • Have solid experience as a welder and/or tack welder
  • Work thoroughly, responsibly, and with a strong focus on quality
  • Can read and understand technical drawings
  • Are reliable and a team player
  • Contribute positively to a professional and safe working environment
  • Speak Danish and/or English
  • Live in Denmark within a reasonable commuting distance of Brande

We can provide certification in various welding methods, so it is not important whether you already hold welding certificates.

Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, please contact our Head of Production, Tomas Slepavicius, at tsl@givesteel.com.

We would like to receive your CV, clearly outlining your relevant experience. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and we will remove the job advertisement once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company that develops, designs, manufactures, and erects load-bearing steel structures and steel trusses. Quality, safety, and documentation are an integral part of our daily operations, while we also maintain a strong focus on CO₂ reduction and responsible production.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our daily work.

title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team

What we offer

  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! title: Rethinking Converter Synchronization: 2-Year Postdoctoral Position in Battery Energy Storage Systems
description:
Are you eager to contribute to a bold experimental research project at the forefront of power electronics and energy storage? We are offering an exciting 2-year postdoctoral position for a talented researcher to investigate advanced converter synchronization and control methods for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), with particular emphasis on exploiting naturally occurring acoustic and vibration information. The project combines converter control, sensing, signal processing, and experimental validation to explore new approaches toward simpler, more robust, and scalable BESS operation. This position is expected to start from 1st of January 2027, or as soon as possible hereafter.

About the projectThe position is affiliated with the VILLUM Experiment project A-choir and the EMI/EMC In Power Electronics research group at AAU Energy. The project investigates new synchronization concepts for multi-converter BESSs by combining power electronics, sensing, signal processing, and control. A particular focus is placed on whether physical signatures naturally generated during converter operation can provide useful information for synchronization and coordination. 

You will join a research environment working across power electronics, EMI/EMC, converter control, multi-physics analysis, and experimental validation with applications including battery energy storage systems and other converter-dominated energy systems, with opportunities for collaboration across disciplines. The position also offers opportunities for international scientific exchange, participation in leading conferences, and may include research visits to relevant academic or industrial partners.

Your work tasksYou will:

  • Develop and investigate synchronization and coordination methods for power electronic converters.
  • Develop sensing and signal-processing methods for acoustic and vibration measurements.
  • Establish and evaluate relationships between physical signatures and converter switching/operating behaviors.
  • Implement and validate the developed methods using real-time control platforms, HIL, and experimental converter setups.
  • Assess the proposed approaches under representative BESS operating conditions, including robustness to interference and multi-converter interactions.
  • Contribute to the coordination of related research activities, and disseminate results through scientific publications, conferences, and project deliverables.

The position may also include a limited amount of teaching and supervision in areas related to your expertise.

Your competenciesWe expect you to have:

  • A PhD in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, or a closely related field.
  • Documented experience in power electronics, power converter modelling and control, converter synchronization, signal processing, EMI/EMC, or related areas.
  • Strong programming and experimental skills using DSP, MATLAB/Simulink, PLECS, hardware-in-the-loop implementation or comparable tools.
  • Experience with one or more relevant methods, such as synchronization and coordination control, digital signal processing, time-frequency analysis, data-driven modelling, or machine learning.
  • Good knowledge of battery storage systems or multi-converter systems; experience with synchronization control, hierarchical control, hardware design, or AI-assisted signal would be an advantage.
  • A strong scientific publication record appropriate to your career stage.
  • The ability to conduct independent research, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate effectively with academic and industrial partners.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

You are not expected to be an expert in all technical areas covering power electronics, acoustic/vibration sensing, signal processing, or machine learning. Strong competence in power converter control and synchronization, together with solid experimental skills and the ability to work across sensing, EMI/EMC, and system-level interactions, is particularly important. We value scientific independence, critical thinking, strong experimental skills, and a rigorous approach to modelling, implementation, validation, and documentation.

Who we areThe position will be based in the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems” at Department of Energy in Aalborg University (AAU Energy). AAU Energy is an international research department at Aalborg University dedicated to developing clean and sustainable energy systems across electrical, thermal, and mechatronic energy technologies. We offer an interdisciplinary research environment, advanced laboratory facilities, and extensive collaboration with industry and academic partners. The department has campuses in Aalborg and Esbjerg; this position is based at the Aalborg campus. Read more at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements Appointment as postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications if relevant.
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. International staff are encouraged, with support from the university, to learn Danish during their employment in order to support their integration into the workplace and Danish society. 

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer, High Voltage (GIS); Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you a seasoned HV engineer with extensive GIS expertise? Do you understand what it takes to specify the right GIS solution and navigate the trade-offs between performance, reliability, cost, footprint and delivery schedules? Can you translate customer requirements into practical, value-driven solutions? Then join our team and help shape the projects that are driving the global transition towards renewable energy!Your position In your new position, you will be a key contributor to our major tender projects, collaborating closely with a team of experienced engineers to translate customer requirements into robust and scalable offerings. Drawing on your expertise in high-voltage GIS solutions, you will help shape technical decisions, collaborate with strategic suppliers, and strengthen our value proposition.Beyond tender activities, you will contribute to the continuous development of our HV competencies, product portfolio, and ways of working, helping strengthen our technical foundation for future growth.You will join our Product Line Management (PLM) Solution Engineering team, a multidisciplinary group collaborating with customers, suppliers and colleagues across the organization.As part of PLM, you will contribute to our ambition of making offshore substations more modular, standardized, and repeatable.You will help define not only the solutions we deliver today, but also the solutions we bring to market tomorrow.Building on our strong offshore substation capabilities, we are also exploring opportunities within onshore substations. Experience with onshore transmission systems, including EHV GIS/AIS, grid transformers, reactive compensation, harmonic filtering or grid connection equipment, will therefore be considered an advantage and may provide opportunities to contribute beyond our offshore portfolio.Working in an international and collaborative environment, you will help transform proven engineering concepts into repeatable products that support the continued growth of renewable energy worldwide.The position is full-time and includes approximately 10-30 travel days per year. We place a high value on flexibility, and most travel can be planned to align with both business requirements and personal preferences."We have built a leading position within offshore substations, and PLM plays a key role in ensuring that we maintain and strengthen that position. By developing scalable solutions, standardizing our products, and challenging established ways of working, we make sure that we are ready to meet the demands of both today’s and tomorrow’s energy markets. We currently support projects across Europe, the UK, North America, and Asia, but our ambition is simple: to be ready wherever the next opportunity emerges."– Jannick Elmbæk Olsen, Director, Product Line ManagementYour tasks & responsibilitiesAs our new Senior High Voltage Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, positioning, and continuous improvement of the products and solutions offered within our offshore substation product line. Working closely with customers, suppliers, procurement, and our project execution teams, you will help shape solutions that remain competitive, scalable, and aligned with future market demands.Your tasks will include:
  • Support tender activities by defining and evaluating 66 kV and 230/275 kV GIS solutions.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and supplier capabilities into competitive product offerings.
  • Optimize solutions with respect to performance, reliability, footprint, cost, and lead time.
  • Develop and maintain the GIS product roadmap in line with future market requirements and emerging technologies.
  • Collaborate with Procurement and strategic suppliers to strengthen competitiveness and drive cost optimization.
  • Contribute to the standardization and modularization of our GIS product portfolio.
  • Ensure a seamless handover of as-sold solutions to our EPC engineering teams.
Your profile & qualifications To succeed in this role, you are an experienced High Voltage Engineer with extensive GIS expertise and a passion for developing competitive solutions for the renewable energy industry.We imagine that you:
  • Hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Have extensive experience with medium- and high-voltage GIS systems, including 66 kV array systems and 230/275 kV transmission-level applications, from offshore wind, utilities, transmission, manufacturing, or EPC projects.
  • Experience with offshore GIS applications, technology qualification, or emerging SF6-free switchgear technologies is considered an advantage.
  • Understand the technical and commercial drivers behind GIS selection, including performance, cost, footprint, weight, and lead time.
  • Are comfortable working with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to balance technical and commercial requirements.
  • Have a strategic mindset and enjoy translating market needs into scalable product offerings.
  • Communicate clearly in English and can translate complex technical topics into sound business decisions.
  • Thrive in a collaborative and international environment and enjoy working across disciplines and cultures.
  • If you also bring experience or exposure to onshore substations, grid connections, or related high-voltage systems, we would be interested to hear about it.
Welcome to Semco Maritime At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   Care to join the movement? Change. With us. Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

description:

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

title: Lead Game Programmer
description:
Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let’s talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here’s what that looks like day to day

  • In collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you’ll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editor

  • You’ll set and communicate the project’s technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical priorities

  • You’ll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needs

  • You’ll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneck

  • You’ll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right time

  • Overall, you’ll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build on

This includes things like...

  • Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibility

  • Implementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friends

  • Profiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connections

  • Breaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affect

  • Staying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolves

You’re a great match if

  • You have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a project

  • You have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative production

  • You're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editor

  • You've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)

  • You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alike

Nice to haves

  • You have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and Swift

  • Experience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online games

  • Interest in multiplayer game design and social features

  • Experience working with automated build pipelines such as Jenkins

  • Experience building systemic or open-world games

What always matters to us at Triband

  • You thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forward

  • You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that culture

  • You believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyone

  • You bring curiosity, generosity, and flexibility, along with strong opinions, especially when they come with reasoning, openness, and a willingness to actually test them

  • You love exploration and experimentation but don’t get too precious when the evidence tells you you’re wrong

  • You value a positive work environment and contribute to keeping the studio a fun and supportive place to be

Practicalities

  • We work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen.

  • For this role we also consider people located outside of Denmark and provide financial (and moral!) support with visa application and relocation.

  • We work a 37-hour work week, with core hours 10-15, and the freedom to start and finish anywhere between 7 and 18.

  • Our working language is English.

We offer

  • Silly but ambitious projects, and the chance to work on and impact great games that reach millions of players.

  • A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged.

  • Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games.

  • A professional development budget to invest in your growth.

  • Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights, team events, you name it.

  • Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).

  • Six weeks of vacation (five standard plus one extra on us).

  • Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement.

  • Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked.

  • Pension plan and private health insurance.

  • Endless amounts of Faxe Kondi.

WHAT THE TRIBAND?Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn't always work out, but we always learn something.We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games, and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.For more info about Triband, check out: triband.net/about

title: HR Country Manager Denmark
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.   As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.  About the job As HR Country Manager, you will be supporting Alfa Laval's Scaling for Future direction, with a focus on Denmark, with 2000 employees and five Danish legal entities. The role in this form is newly established, giving you a fantastic opportunity to influence the position and make it your own!  The position supports several types of organizations in Denmark and Scandinavia, such as sales companies, factories, shared services, business units, and product groups. The key priority will be to ensure HR alignment across the legal entities and compliance with Danish legislation and collective agreements. You will contribute to harmonizing people policies and practices and as a trusted partner, you will support and inspire management by proactively driving organizational, leadership, and competence development.  You will act as:     HR Country Manager for Denmark, ensuring alignment, compliance, and consistent HR practices across all five legal entities across four sites - Søborg, Kolding, Aalborg and Nakskov.     HR Representative in the Danish Country Council, coordinating national HR topics and providing a consolidated HR view to business leaders in the country council     HR Business Partner for Søborg Site Services and the HR Shared Services Scandinavia organization.     Local HR responsibility for the Søborg site, including Site Management, the Works Council, the Work Environment Council, and the Crisis Management Team.     The one responsible for overall country-level approach to unions, including ensuring alignment in union relationships, works council cooperation and collective agreement governance and also provide guidance together with HR Shared Services on employee relations areas.  Operational responsibilities:    Plan and drive national HR focus areas for the five Danish entities aligned with the business strategy and People Strategy.     Develop and implement people policies, processes, routines, guidelines, tools and analytics.     Ensure country-wide consistency for benefits frameworks, allowances, principles, policies.     Coordinate the salary budget and review process in Denmark together with the Employee Relations team in HR Shared Services     Drive, support and inspire management in organizational, leadership, and competence development.     Coordinate local HR activities at the Søborg site, including collaboration with employee representatives and relevant councils.  Travel is part of the job, mainly to our various sites in Denmark, but you will also have a few travel days a year within Europe. You will be part of the Danish Country Council management team as well as part of the Søborg Site Management team. You report to Per Lund Hansen, a manager who will give you freedom and mandate to perform at your best. You will also have a dotted line to our VP Total Rewards and HR Shared Services, Gabriella Nagy Olofsson.  Who you are You are an experienced and confident HR professional, who is ready to take on the role as a trusted sparring partner for managers and leaders. You bring a genuine interest in understanding the business and getting to know our people. To succeed we see you as a strong communicator able to create engagement, participation, and clarity. You are people-oriented and build good solid relationships and have the know-how in leading through others. You make decisions with overall perspective and consider the needs of the entire organization.  Requirements:     Solid experience from a similar role within a larger international matrix organization and a strong background in country-level HR governance.     In-depth knowledge of Danish labour law, industrial relations, negotiations and collective agreements.     Experience in leading and coordinating change work, developing and implementing HR processes, routines, and guidelines.     Good ability to work in HR systems     Excellent communication skills in Danish and English and the ability to formulate clear and well-structured routines, guidelines, and strategic documents.     Completed university education in HR of at least 180 ECTS credits, or an equivalent education deemed relevant by the employer.     Driving license. We do not accept applications via email, due to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 18, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!  While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing close to our office in Søborg, Denmark. We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.  #LI-CL1

title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 14:00–22:00 or 16:00–22:00
  • Night shifts: 23:00–06:00

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?
  • Flexible work: Choose when and where you want to work, depending on available shifts and assignments.
  • Earn extra money: Perfect if you’re studying or looking to boost your income ahead of the holidays.
  • Get valuable experience: Develop your skills in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Opportunities for the future: Show us what you can do and you may have the chance to move into a permanent position.
  • Great benefits: Including pension and holiday pay.
Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who:

  • Are reliable, motivated, and ready to get stuck in.
  • Bring positive energy and enjoy being part of a team.
  • Are comfortable working independently when needed.
  • Are physically fit and able to handle tasks involving heavy lifting.

Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not a requirement. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter most!

Be part of the Black Friday rush!

Peak season is approaching fast, and we’re getting ready for the busiest time of the year. Join the HumanizeR team in Ringsted, gain valuable experience, and earn extra money while helping keep Denmark’s parcels moving.

Ready to get started? Apply today and join us for peak season!

title: Puhastustööde juht
description:
Tööülesanded: Korraldad sise- ja tootmisruumide igapäevast koristust ning eripuhastustöid. Juhid 35-liikmelist meeskonda: osaled töötajate värbamises, juhendad ja koolitad töötajaid, koostad töögraafikuid ning korraldad asendusi. Kontrollid isiklikult objektidel töö kvaliteeti ja ohutusnõuete järgimist, selgitad välja puuduste põhjused ning tagad nende kõrvaldamise. Arvutad Excelis tööajanorme, töömahte, personali- ja materjalivajadust ning teenuste omahinda ja maksumust. Analüüsid kulusid ja ressursside kasutamise tõhusust. Suhtled klientidega, koostad ja põhjendad hinnapakkumisi, lepid kokku töökorralduslikke muudatusi ning lahendad igapäevaseid küsimusi ja pretensioone. Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Muud nõuded: Kehtiv Puhastustööde juht, tase 5 kutsetunnistus. Puhastustööde korraldamise ja meeskonna juhtimise kogemus, vähemalt 3 aastat. Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

description:
Tööülesanded: Otsime kahte väikeklassi õpetajat:- ühte I kooliastmesse; - ühte III kooliastmesse. *Väikeklassi õpilaste õpetamine ja toetamine vastavalt kooli õppekavale ning õpilaste individuaalsetele vajadustele. *Õppetöö planeerimine, ettevalmistamine ja läbiviimine ning õppeprotsessi kohandamine vastavalt õpilaste võimekusele ja arengule. *Õpilaste individuaalse arengu, õpitulemuste ja toimetuleku jälgimine ning nende arenguks vajaliku toe pakkumine. *Turvalise, rahuliku ja toetava õpikeskkonna kujundamine ning õpilaste sotsiaalsete ja eneseregulatsioonioskuste toetamine. *Õpilaste juhendamine igapäevastes koolielu ja õppimisega seotud tegevustes ning nende iseseisvuse arendamine. *Õpilaste õppetöö ja arengu kohta vajaliku dokumentatsiooni täitmine. *Koostöö klassi- ja aineõpetajate, tugispetsialistide, kooli juhtkonna ja lapsevanematega õpilaste arengu ning õppimise toetamisel. *Vajadusel õppetöö ja õppematerjalide kohandamine ning erinevate õppemeetodite kasutamine. *Õpilaste kaasamine kooli ühistegevustesse ning nende sotsiaalsete oskuste ja positiivse suhtumise kujundamine. *Osalemine kooli õppe- ja kasvatustööga seotud tegevustes, koosolekutel ja arendustegevustes.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Toetavat ja sõbralikku meeskonda ning head koostööd väärtustavat töökeskkonda.*Võimalust töötada väikeklassis ja panustada õpilaste individuaalsesse arengusse. *Võimalust kujundada oma töö sisu ning rakendada oma teadmisi ja ideid õppetöö korraldamisel. *Erialaseid arengu- ja koolitusvõimalusi. *Kuni 5 tasustatud tervisepäeva aastas. *Kooli spordirajatiste tasuta kasutamise võimalust. *Töötasu vastavalt töökoormusele, kvalifikatsioonile ja töökogemusele. *Kaasaegset ja toetavat töökeskkonda Kallavere Koolis. *Võimalust olla osa kooli ühisest arengust ja panustada turvalise ning toetava koolikeskkonna kujundamisse.

Muud nõuded: *Hea eesti keele oskus.*Valmidus töötada väikeklassi õpilastega ning arvestada nende individuaalsete vajadustega. *Hea suhtlemis- ja koostööoskus. *Kannatlikkus, paindlikkus ja rahulik meel. *Valmidus teha koostööd õpetajate, tugispetsialistide ja lapsevanematega. *Positiivne ja toetav suhtumine õpilastesse. *Hea arvuti kasutamise oskus ning valmisolek kasutada õppetöös digivahendeid. *Vastutustundlikkus ja kohusetundlikkus. *Magistikraad võib olla omandamisel.

title: Civil Site Coordinator
description: **The opportunity**Are you ready to play an important role in delivering the infrastructure that enables the energy transition?We are looking for a Civil Site Coordinator to join our Nordic Site Management organization at Hitachi Energy. In this role, you will coordinate civil construction activities and contribute to the successful delivery of Grid Integration and substation projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.You will work closely with Site Managers, project teams, contractors and other stakeholders, helping ensure that civil works are planned and executed safely, efficiently and to a high standard. This is an excellent opportunity to work in an international project environment and contribute to some of the key projects shaping the future of the Nordic power grid.The position can be based in Finland (Helsinki, Tampere or Vaasa), Sweden (Västerås, Ludvika or Stockholm) or Denmark (Middelfart or Ballerup). Depending on the project phase, the role involves travel to project sites approximately 2–3 days per week in Finland, Sweden or Denmark.**How you'll make an impact****\-** Coordinate civil construction activities for projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.\- Support Site Managers throughout project execution and help ensure smooth site operations.\- Coordinate interfaces between civil and electrical disciplines.\- Support resource planning and workforce coordination according to project needs.\- Participate in tendering, constructability reviews and execution planning.\- Support inspections, handovers and preparations for commissioning.\- Work closely with project teams, contractors and other stakeholders to ensure effective coordination.\- Promote a strong safety culture and high-quality performance across project sites.**Your background**\- You have a technical education in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related field.\- You have experience in substation, infrastructure, energy, construction or industrial projects.\- You have strong coordination, communication and collaboration skills.\- You are comfortable working with several stakeholders in an international project environment.\- You are proactive, structured and able to adapt to changing project needs.\- Fluent written and spoken skills in local language. Strong skills in English.\- You are willing and able to travel regularly across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.

title: Liikunnanohjaaja
description: Lappeenrannan kaupungin liikuntapalvelut hakee liikunnanohjaajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Liikunnanohjaajan tehtävä sisältää monipuolisesti erilaisten liikuntaryhmien ohjausta, sekä uinninvalvontaa.Uinninvalvontatyössä vastaat asiakaspalveluhenkisesti asiakkaiden turvallisuudesta, sekä muista uimahallin päivittäiseen toimintaan liittyvistä tehtävistä. Uinninvalvoja huolehtii uimahallin järjestyksestä ja sääntöjen noudattamisesta.Tehtävässä ohjataan työikäisten ja senioreiden matalan kynnyksen liikuntaryhmiä. Ryhmät voivat olla esimerkiksi kuntosaliohjauksia, vesiliikuntatunteja, kehonhuoltotunteja tai muita eri välinein ja kehonpainolla ohjattavia liikuntatunteja. Lisäksi työ voi sisältää kuntalaisille tarkoitettuja kuntosali- ja vesijuoksuopastuksia. Tehtävässä on mahdollista päästä mukaan edistämään kuntalaisten liikkumista esimerkiksi erilaisia tapahtumia järjestämällä.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on liikunnanohjauksen perustutkinto tai muu tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, sekä tehtävään soveltuva työkokemus. Tehtävään valittavan tulee suorittaa hyväksytysti SUH:n uinninvalvojan testiuinti ennen työsuhteen aloitusta. Katsomme eduksi kokemuksen uimahalliympäristössä toimimisesta, sekä vesiliikunnan ohjaamisesta.Tehtävässä edellytetään kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti, sekä osana liikunnanohjaajien ja uinninvalvojien tiimiä. Lisäksi edellytämme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja. Odotamme hakijalta itseohjautuvaa työotetta, kykyä toimia muuttuvissakin tilanteissa, sekä ongelmanratkaisutaitoa.Viikkotyöaika on KVTES:n yleistyöajan mukainen 38,25 tuntia viikossa. Työtä tehdään pääasiassa kahdessa vuorossa, jolloin aamuvuoro on yleisesti klo 6-14 ja iltavuoro klo 12-20. Työtä tehdään sekä Lappeenrannan että Lauritsalan uimahalleilla. Tarkempi työpiste sovitaan erikseen. Tehtävä sisältää työtä myös viikonloppuisin. Tehtävän aloitus sopimuksen mukaan vuoden 2027 alussa. Voimme aloittaa haastattelut jo hakuaikana.Liikkumisen edistämisen palveluyksikkö tarjoaa ohjattua liikuntaa kaikenikäisille kuntalaisille Lappeenrannassa. Liikunnanohjaajien ohjaamat terveysliikuntaryhmät on suunnattu kaikenikäisille kaupunkilaisille. Ryhmät ovat matalan kynnyksen liikuntaryhmiä, joissa tärkein tavoitteemme on lisätä kuntalaisten liikunnan harrastamista sekä tarjota terveyttä edistävää ja ylläpitävää liikuntaa.

title: Enhetschef (familjeledighetsvikariat)
description: **VI SÖKER EN ENHETSCHEF!****– Vill du vara med och göra skillnad för barn, unga och familjer?**Luna Familjecenter söker en engagerad och ansvarstagande **enhetschef till vår verksamhet för periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS) och övriga öppenvårdstjänster**.Tjänsten är ett **familjeledighetsvikariat på ett år**, från och med 4.1.2027 eller enligt överenskommelse, med möjlighet till förlängning.Vi söker dig som trivs med att leda och utveckla verksamhet, skapa struktur och arbeta nära både personal, klienter och samarbetsparter.**Om vår verksamhet**Luna Familjecenter erbjuder mångsidiga socialvårdstjänster för barn, unga och familjer. Vårt arbete präglas av ett systemiskt förhållningssätt där vi ser till barnets och familjens hela livssituation, med fokus på delaktighet, trygghet och individuella behov.**Periodiskt professionellt stöd (PPS)** är en av våra öppenvårdstjänster och bedrivs vid vår enhet **Tomtebo i centrala Jakobstad**.Verksamheten erbjuder planerade stöddygn där barn och unga får vistas och övernatta i en trygg och hemlik miljö med stöd av professionell personal. Stöddygnen utformas individuellt utifrån barnets och familjens behov och målsättningar.Syftet är att stöda barnets välbefinnande, utveckling och vardagsfärdigheter samt bidra till att stärka familjens resurser och fungerande vardag. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med barnets vårdnadshavare och ansvariga sociala myndigheter.Barn och unga som får stöddygn kan även ha andra öppenvårdsinsatser, såsom stödperson eller familjearbete. När dessa insatser är knutna till stöddygnen ansvarar enhetschefen även för att koordinera och samordna uppdragen, så att stödet bildar en fungerande helhet utifrån barnets och familjens behov.**Om tjänsten**Som enhetschef har du ett övergripande ansvar för verksamhetens personal, dagliga arbete och klientprocesser.**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:**- Leda, stöda och utveckla personalgruppen samt ansvara för personalfrågor. - Ansvara för planering, genomförande, uppföljning och utvärdering av klienternas individuella stödinsatser. - Planera och samordna verksamhetens resurser och bemanning. - Säkerställa ett gott samarbete med sociala myndigheter, vårdnadshavare och övriga samarbetsparter. - Ansvara för verksamhetens kvalitet, struktur och kontinuerliga utveckling. - Ingå i Luna Familjecenters ledningsgrupp och aktivt bidra till utvecklingen av hela organisationens verksamhet. **Behörighetskrav**För tjänsten förutsätts:- **Lämplig utbildning inom social- eller hälsovårdsbranschen**, exempelvis socionom (YH), sjukskötare (YH) eller socialarbetare, samt registrering som yrkesutbildad person inom social- eller hälsovården. - title: SAS DIS Lead Developer
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAS Data Integration Studio (DIS) Lead Developer, preferably with the capability and experience to also work in a Solution Architect role. The consultant will be responsible for the architecture and technical design of SAS 9.x data integration, data warehouse and data mart solutions. The role includes designing and developing ETL/ELT pipelines using SAS Data Integration Studio, Base SAS and SQL, translating business, reporting, regulatory and operational requirements into solution designs, and defining data models, transformation rules and reusable technical standards.

Key Responsibilities Solution Architecture and Design:
· Own the architecture and technical design of SAS 9.x data integration, data warehouse and data mart solutions.
· Translate business, reporting, regulatory and operational requirements into logical and physical solution designs.
· Design and develop robust ETL and ELT pipelines using SAS Data Integration Studio, Base SAS and SQL.
· Define source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, data flows, dependencies, restart points and error-handling patterns.
· Design and develop and guide conceptual, logical and physical data models, including dimensional, normalized or vault-style models where appropriate.
· Establish reusable standards for job structures, naming, parameterization, logging, auditing, exception handling and documentation.
· Evaluate architectural trade-offs involving data movement, database pushdown, SAS processing, storage, scheduling and downstream consumption.

Required Experience:
· SQL (mandatory)
· ETL (mandatory)
· Databricks · SAS, DI studio (mandatory)
· SAS Base (mandatory)

Background check needed will be informed if candidate is chosen.

- Have you previously been responsible for the technical architecture and solution design of SAS-based data warehouses or data marts?*
- Do you have practical experience working with Databricks in data engineering or data integration projects?*

title: IOS and Android Engineers
description:
Were looking for an iOS Engineer to help develop the features and functionality of the mobile app. More than two million users have downloaded and activated the app, so reliability, security and quality are central to our work.

Role #1
Youll work in an agile, cross-functional team, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, designers, backend developers and QA engineers. The iOS app is primarily built with Swift, with parts using RxSwift, SwiftUI and Combine.
 
What youll do:
- Develop and maintain high-quality features for the mobile app.
- Contribute to architectural discussions and identify dependencies between systems.
- Write clean, maintainable code and take part in code reviews.
- Build and maintain unit, integration and automated tests.
- Work closely with colleagues across disciplines to deliver a great user experience.

Requirements:
Role #1
- Experience developing mobile applications for iOS and a good understanding of the iOS SDK.
- Strong Swift and UIKit skills, and knowledge of modern iOS development practices.
- An understanding of software development best practices, including testing and writing high-quality code.
- A willingness to build and maintain test automation.
- Clear communication skills, a collaborative mindset and fluency in English.
- The ability to work with complex integrations and adapt to new technologies and ways of working.
Experience with RxSwift, SwiftUI, Combine and Xcode is beneficial.
 
Additional experience thats a plus: VIPER architecture, cybersecurity, accessibility, Splunk, loyalty programmes or banking.

Role #2
Were looking for an experienced Senior Android Engineer to take on the role of Lead Android Engineer for the mobile app. Youll help develop its features and functionality, while taking ownership of technical direction and supporting strong engineering practices across the team.
 
More than 2.5 million users have downloaded and activated the app, making reliability and quality essential. Youll work in an agile team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, designers, developers and QA engineers.
 
What youll do:
- Develop and maintain high-quality Android features for the mobile app.
- Guide architectural and technical decisions, and plan code maintenance and refactoring.
- Promote clean code, modern Android practices and testing, including unit, integration and UI tests.
- Help establish effective processes and create clear technical documentation.
- Take ownership of technical quality and share knowledge within the mobile competence community.

Role #2
- Strong experience developing mobile applications for Android.
- Strong Kotlin skills and experience with Jetpack Compose, RxJava, Dagger2 and custom UI.
- Knowledge of modern Android development practices, architecture and test-driven development.
- The ability to drive technical decisions, apply good engineering practices and take ownership.
- Experience with Google Play Services.
- Good communication skills in English and an active, collaborative approach to knowledge sharing.
 
Additional experience thats a plus: Previous technical leadership, mobile accessibility, test automation, Android CI/CD or other DevOps experience, information security, AWS, Java or Swift. A proactive attitude and willingness to learn are also valued.

title: Business Cutover Lead
description:
For our client, we are looking for a Business Cutover Lead.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Description: 
The Customer is currently implementing SAP S/4HANA as a core ERP system. The aim is to go live in May 2027. To support the go live preparations, the Customer is looking for an experienced Business Cutover Lead to join the programme team.
The Business Cutover Lead will ensure that the business transition from the legacy systems to the new solution at the go-live happens with minimal disruption to operations.
 
Main responsibilities of the Business Cutover Lead:
1. Business cutover planning: Develop and maintain the business cutover plan in coordination with the program streams including activities (in Jira), dependencies, owners, milestones, and timing.
2. Business readiness: Coordinate and track business readiness across streams including people/competence, processes, data, and controls/metrics.
3. Business Cutover execution management: Consolidate and report the business readiness status, unresolved issues, and risks to the Program Leadership. Support the Go/No-Go decisions. Communicate cutover schedules, responsibilities, decisions, and status to the stakeholders.
4. Hypercare and stabilisation: Coordinate business support during initial operations. Monitor critical processes with the set controls/metrics and in cooperation with the line management leading the change. Prioritise issues, coordinate the retirement of contingency tools and procedures, and support the transition to business-as-usual operations.
5. Cutover rehearsals: Coordinate the business participation in cutover rehearsals, validate business activities, timings, dependencies, resources, and contingency procedures, and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into the final cutover plan.
 
Required skills and d experience:
 Extensive experience in a business cutover role: Has led business cutover activities in several SAP S/4HANA greenfield implementations (private cloud solution)
 Deep understanding of cutover activities and methodology
 Proactive and ability to drive activities independently to completion
 Strong project management skills

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Espoo. Likely a lot can be done remote, but a fair amount of onsite presence needed too. 
Start: asap
Duration: until June 2027
Allocation: 100 % 
Language: English

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application!

title: Oppaita talvisesonkiin

title: Senior Finance Data & AI engineer
description: **About the role** As a Senior Finance Data & AI Engineer, you will build and develop Finance-owned data, AI and application solutions across areas such as closing, controlling, tax, treasury and financial transactional services.Embedded within Finance, you will work closely with different finance teams to turn business challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You will also provide technical leadership for the teams engineering output by establishing common standards and reusable patterns, supporting colleagues and taking ownership of the most complex and business-critical solutions.**Key responsibilities**- Partner with finance teams to translate business needs into scalable data, AI and application solutions, leading complex and cross-functional builds from concept to production. - Design and build data pipelines, machine learning and GenAI solutions, AI agents and user-facing applications using Databricks, Azure or other relevant technologies - Own the full solution lifecycle, including architecture, development, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, model evaluation and retraining. - Establish reusable engineering and application patterns, including pipeline templates, agent frameworks, shared components and UI design systems. - Set and promote standards for code quality, testing, MLOps, security, maintainability, accessibility and usability, while contributing to platform and technology decisions. - Mentor colleagues, conduct technical reviews and act as an escalation point for complex builds, using AI-enabled development tools to improve delivery speed and quality. **What we are looking for**- At least five years of experience in data, AI or software engineering, including technical leadership or architecture ownership across a solution portfolio. - Strong expertise in Python, SQL, data engineering, machine learning, GenAI and LLM/agent frameworks, together with experience building production-grade applications. - Hands-on experience with Databricks and Azure, including CI/CD, Azure DevOps or equivalent, and Data/ML/AI Ops practices. - Strong application and front-end architecture capabilities, including reusable component design, design systems and maintainable user interfaces at scale. - A bachelors or masters degree in computer science, data/AI engineering, software engineering or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Strong stakeholder skills are essential; finance process Knowledge and relevant Azure, Databricks or AI certifications are considered advantages. Agile scrum master experience considered advantage**Growth opportunities**This role offers the opportunity to develop into a technical or delivery lead covering Finances broader engineering portfolio. From there, the career path may progress toward senior architecture and technical leadership, platform and solution strategy, or broader end-to-end solution ownership.**Please apply latest: 29th of November****For more information please contact:** Senior Manager – Finance Business Analytics Nenad Veselinovic **via phone +358407795483 during contact hours**: 20th Nov 11-12 or 27th Nov 11-12 EET.**The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment**

Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!Contio HenkilöstöpalvelutSähköposti: joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Rauma

title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja, Turku
description: _Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tämän vuoksi vaadimme hakijalta B-ajokorttia.Hakijalta odotamme aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähkö- tai automaatioalan koulutusta sekä kokemusta sähkö- ja automaatioalan asennuksista. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. Työntekijältä vaaditaan voimassa olevia tulityö-, työturvallisuus- ja EA-kortteja.Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työtä tehdään arkisin päivävuorossa, työaikojen kuitenkin ollessa työskentelykohteista riippuen joustavia. Työkielenä käytetään suomea, joten suomen kielen taito on ehdoton.
