title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Radiographers with mammography experience wanted in Iceland
description: Are you interested in working abroad while advancing your career within breast imaging and mammography? We are seeking experienced radiographers with mammography expertise for a leading hospital in Iceland.This is an excellent opportunity to work in a modern university hospital environment, performing both screening and diagnostic mammography alongside experienced colleagues in a highly specialized multidisciplinary team. The department is committed to delivering high-quality patient care, patient safety, continuous improvement, and professional development.Period: 6–12 months, with start as soon as possible.Key Responsibilities    Perform mammography examinations in both screening and diagnostic breast imaging    Ensure patients receive a professional, caring, and sensitive service throughout the examination process    Travel to different locations across Iceland during parts of the year to perform mobile screening mammography    Maintain accurate documentation in the department’s information systems    Actively participate in quality improvement initiatives and the ongoing development of breast imaging services    Carry out specialized duties within the department as required    Contribute to the delivery of high-quality diagnostic imaging services    Work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team to provide the highest standard of patient careWe Are Looking For    A licensed Radiographer.    At least two years of documented experience in mammography and breast imaging    Eligibility to obtain a professional license to practice in Iceland    Good English skills, both spoken and written    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with a professional attitude    The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player    A reliable, structured, and proactive approach to work    Hold a valid license as a Radiographer from an EU/EEA country    A commitment to contributing to a positive and collaborative working environment    Flexibility and willingness to work in an international healthcare settingWe Offer    A rewarding position at Iceland’s leading university hospital    A comprehensive onboarding program and support from experienced colleagues    A positive and welcoming work environment with a strong team culture    Excellent opportunities for professional development and learning    Competitive salary conditions according to Icelandic collective agreements    Free accommodation throughout the assignment period    Paid round-trip travel at the beginning and end of the assignment    Assistance with obtaining Icelandic professional registration and authorization    Valuable international work experience in a highly specialized breast imaging departmentWhy Iceland?An assignment in Iceland offers you the unique opportunity to combine your professional career with the experience of living in one of the Nordic region’s most fascinating countries.Here, you will find dramatic volcanic life.For many healthcare professionals, it is the combination of professional development and life outside of work that makes an experience in Iceland truly special. You will gain valuable international work experience, broaden your professional perspective, and have the opportunity to explore the country in a way that goes far beyond a typical holiday.Interested?Get in touch to learn more about this exciting opportunity in Iceland, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. Interested?📧 Apply by clicking the link to access the vacancy on JBT Marel´s website: https://jbtm.wd108.myworkdayjobs.com/JBT_Marel_Career_Site/job/IS---Gardabaer/Information-Security-Officer--Junior-_25689.🌐 Learn more about us at: JBTMarel.com🔗 Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/jbtmarel/Last application date is November 17, 2026. Join us - and help shape the future of maintenance excellence at JBT Marel.Use of Technology in Our Hiring ProcessJBT Marel uses technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support the review of applications.These tools help our recruiting teams identify skills and experience relevant to the role based on job-related criteria.All applications are reviewed by people, and AI is not used to make hiring decisions independently. We are committed to fair, consistent and inclusive hiring practices globally.

title: Engineering Manager
description: Fenris Creations is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the infrastructure engineering team behind EVE Online.EVE runs as a single shared universe, where every player has an opportunity to leave a mark on a 20-year running persistent game experience. Our game cluster spans our own datacenter hardware and AWS. Our tight-knit team owns this infrastructure end-to-end: servers and network gear in the racks, the cloud networks and Golang domain specific services in AWS, and the incident, change management, testing, alerting, automation, and budget processes that keep it all running.You'll lead the engineers who build and run that platform. You'll set technical direction, own reliability and cost, and stay close enough to the work to make good calls during an outage or a hardware refresh. This is a hands-on management role.The role is based in Reykjavík, Iceland. We are a hybrid office, and offer flexibility around which days are in-office and which can be worked remotely.Your Tasks:Lead the teamHire, coach, and grow infrastructure engineers. Run 1:1s, give performance feedback, and guide career growth.Set the team's priorities across new platform work, requests from game teams, operational load, and technical debt.Run planning with product owners and other engineering leads.Own reliabilityRun the incident management process: on-call rotations and expectations, escalation paths, alerting, and blameless postmortems.Guide production change management, setting policy on deployment reviews, maintenance windows, and rollback plans, and so on.Define and track SLIs and SLOs for core services and set team priorities in response.Own the platformGuide architecture for our on-premise datacenter and AWS environments, and how traffic moves between them.Oversee hardware lifecycle: procurement, bare-metal provisioning, firmware and OS updates, and decommissioning.Own network design and security across both environments, from Cisco routers and firewalls to VPCs, Transit Gateways, and access controls.Push for automation wherever possible, in provisioning, configuration, CI/CD, and observability, to minimize engineering TOIL.Own the budgetSet the cloud and on-premise infrastructure budgets, and forecast spend as the game grows.Manage vendor relationships and contracts with cloud, datacenter, CDN, and tooling providers.Find and deliver cost savings without trading away reliability.Your Profile:Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.8+ years in infrastructure, systems, site reliability, or distributed systems engineering.2+ years managing engineers directly, including hiring and performance management.Strong grasp of distributed systems — message queues, service discovery, consistency, failure modes, and how to debug them in production.Hands-on experience running physical hardware in a datacenter — bare-metal provisioning, server and storage lifecycle, and working with colocation providers.Deep cloud provider experience, especially in networking and security (VPCs, Transit Gateways, routing, security groups) and running services at scale.Solid networking fundamentals — TCP/IP, routing protocols such as BGP, VLANs, firewalls, and router configuration.Experience leading incident response and building on-call and postmortem practices.Comfort reading and reviewing code in Golang or Python.Experience owning or forecasting an infrastructure budget.Strong technical writing and spoken communication skills in English — design docs, tradeoff analyses — and a track record of driving complex, cross-functional technical projects across multiple project and executive stakeholders.Nice to have:Experience with RabbitMQ, NATS, or other message brokers in production.Experience with DynamoDB and Redis.Automation with Python and Ansible.Bare-metal provisioning with PXE boot, Tinkerbell, or similar tools.Infrastructure as code with Terraform, and CI/CD with TeamCity or GitHub Actions.Observability tooling such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Honeycomb.Background in game services or other low-latency, high-concurrency systems.Experience with hybrid on-premise and cloud environments, or migrations between them.Our stackOur cloud platform is a set of Golang microservices in AWS, built around a service gateway and RabbitMQ message queues. On-premise, we run our own servers and Cisco network gear in the datacenter, managed with Ansible and Python.Area.Tools.Languages.Golang, Python.Messaging.RabbitMQ, NATS.Data.DynamoDB, Redis.Cloud.AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateways, EKS).Datacenter.Cisco routers, PXE boot, Ansible.Automation and CI/CD.Terraform, TeamCity.What We Can Offer You:The chance to work on EVE Online with talented, ambitious colleagues.A multicultural workplace that encourages growth and new ideas.Dual-monitor workstation and a flexible work environment.An active fun division that hosts regular events.A canteen with weekly breakfast and lunch menus, plus drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual. performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.Mobile phone and mobile plan.Home internet.Conditional monthly transportation grant.Free on-site doctor and other on-site. services at a discount.Relocation package.Please submit your application in English by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/29d70840-8361-4fc9-ac2a-de524d85fba0

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. title: Healthcare Assistant
description: This position involves a 39-hour week, at €16.12 per hour, based at our Dublin location (D03KW08)Main responsibilities:     To deliver quality care to each resident    To assist residents with intimate and personal care, based on assessed needs     To assist residents with eating and drinking where and when appropriate    To promote and encourage a normal nutritional diet     To assist residents with mobilizing    To assist with diversional therapy i.e. activities, movement to music etc.     Assist nursing staff with all the resident care and the care of the dying    Be familiar with the control of infection    Report any changes in residents’ condition to senior nurse on duty    At night to ensure residents sleep patterns are not unduly disrupted by excessive noise and bright lights    Document any records you are required to keep in the course of your duty. title: Residential Care Worker
description: Are you passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of children? Do you thrive in a dynamic and supportive work environment? We have the perfect opportunity for you! Join our team at Ashdale Care (Ireland), on our journey to transform the lives of young people with complex, emotional and behavioural needs.No two days are the same here in Ashdale Care, this job description is designed to be flexible and adaptable, providing guiding principles for the work rather than strict limitations. It will undergo periodic review to ensure alignment with evolving organisational needs.  You will be part of a unique team who will work together to facilitate excellent practice and be part of rebuilding children’s lives. Our vision is for every young person who lives with us to experience a safe, happy and nurturing present and a future that is filled with hope and optimism.    Cultivate genuine and caring connections with the young people, always interact with the young people and their families with dignity and respect, promoting a culture of unconditional positive regard.    Contribute to the promotion, creation, and maintenance of a welcoming, safe, caring, stable and therapeutic environment.    Advocate for the rights and responsibilities of each young person while promoting physical, emotional, social, cultural, ethnic, and spiritual wellbeing.    Ensure that young people are not subjected to any forms of abuse and report any concerns according to policy and procedures.    Supervise outings from the home and undertake daily household activities such as cooking and cleaning, as part of positive modelling.    Actively participate in working within the Model of Therapeutic Care.    Be physically able to support with challenging behaviours when needed.    Provide emotional support during difficult or stressful times and encourage young people's participation in care planning, placement planning, decision-making and service delivery.    Integrate understanding of youth trauma and past experiences into practice through specialised training such as Developmental Trauma and Attachment from the Therapeutic Support Team.    Collaborate with support networks, including social workers and educators, guardians and family members.    Collaborate effectively within a team, engaging in regular communication through daily handovers, team meetings, and various reviews and planning sessions. Give and receive feedback on performance with colleagues and managers.    Maintain consistency in execution of childcare plans.    Complete and maintain accurate records and reports for each young person in line with statutory requirements and Ashdale Care policies and procedures.    Take on key worker duties including the handling of daily petty cash, accurately documenting receipts, securely storing money and valuable items and serving as a primary point of contact for professionals/family/young person.

description: RBK is seeking a high-performing Transfer Pricing Senior to join our International Tax – Transfer Pricing (TP) Team. Working directly with our Transfer Pricing Director, you will support a varied portfolio of multinationals, mid-market companies and fast-growing international businesses across transfer pricing, tax compliance and advisory.The role can be tailored to your experience and career goals, whether you wish to broaden your consultancy experience across tax, focus on compliance or develop a specialist area.ResponsibilitiesManage end-to-end TP projects, including scoping, benchmarking, documentation (local and master files) and financial/economic analysis.Draft and review TP reports, technical memoranda, intercompany agreements, intangible pricing, intra-group services and cost allocations.Handle client queries and conduct functional, industry and economic analyses to support pricing models.Support TP audits and disputes, defend documentation before tax authorities and contribute to dispute prevention and resolution.Apply and monitor OECD/G20 BEPS guidance, EU and local TP regulations.Build client relationships, understand business models, value chains and risks, and align TP policies with commercial strategies.Collaborate across tax, finance, legal and operations on structuring, cross-border transactions, supply chains, IP and intra-group financing.Review junior colleagues' work, provide coaching and feedback, and contribute to training and knowledge sharing.Manage project budgets, billing and WIP, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery.Support business development through proposals, client pitches and practice growth.Requirements2–4 years' relevant TP experience in a professional services consulting firm.Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines, the BEPS framework and local TP regulations.Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Per rafforzare il team Demand & Supply Planning, ricerchiamo un/una Demand Planner Assistant con forte attitudine analitica, precisione e capacità di coordinamento. description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Contribuire al miglioramento continuo di processi FP&A, automazione del reporting e metodologie di pianificazione. Lavorare in modo cross-funzionale con Accounting, Operations, HR, Fleet, Procurement e altre funzioni per una vista completa della performance. Esperienza di 3-5+ anni in FP&A/Controllo di Gestione/Finance Business Partnering (preferibile in contesti strutturati o società di consulenza). Solida conoscenza di: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, reporting gestionale, closing support. Forte capacità analitica e attitudine a trasformare i dati in insight e azioni. Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office (Excel), e familiarità con ERP aziendali (es. SAP). Conoscenza fluente della lingua italiana e buona della lingua inglese (livello B2). Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, approccio proattivo, autonomia, attenzione al dettaglio e orientamento ai risultati completano il profilo. Orario di lavoro: full time lun - ven. title: Tecnico_a di messa in servizio
description:
Hai sempre desiderato lavorare in un settore dinamico e orientato al futuro, contribuendo così alla produzione di energia sostenibile e rinnovabile? Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare un futuro verde insieme a Thöni Sustainable Solutions! Da oltre 30 anni realizziamo impianti di biogas in tutto il mondo e siamo leader tecnologici in questo settore. 1 Tecnico_a di messa in servizio Location:

Italia

Type of Employment:

Full time

Your tasks

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Controlli funzionali e di sicurezza di tutti i sistemi in conformità alle norme tecniche

* Regolazione e ottimizzazione dei parametri dell'impianto per un funzionamento conforme al contratto

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

* Formazione e istruzione del personale operativo in loco

* Documentazione dei lavori eseguiti e verbali di consegna

* Stretta collaborazione con i responsabili di progetto, i tecnici e il team di assistenza

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. Sede di lavoro: San Giovanni Teatino (CH), con contributo mensile alla relocation per candidati/e provenienti da fuori regione. Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. Budget: RAL 45.000€ in base all'effettiva seniority 2gg di settimanli Smart working Location Provincia di Monza SUD EST #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: consulente legale
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. For a client company operating in the technology and travel sector, we are looking for a: POLICY AND REGULATORY MANAGER - SOUTHERN EUROPE What will you be responsible for? Developing and implementing regulatory strategies and compliance solutions across Southern Europe, with a primary focus on Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Managing relationships with local and national governments, regulatory authorities, tax authorities and other institutional stakeholders. Monitoring and analysing tax and fiscal regulations, particularly those concerning short-term rentals, tourist tax collection, registration and data sharing. Managing agreements with Italian municipalities on tourist tax and supporting regulatory negotiations and legislative initiatives. Collaborating with legal, product and international teams to develop compliance tools, regulatory policies and solutions. Preparing policy papers, regulatory analyses and position statements, while identifying partnership opportunities with public institutions and external stakeholders. Do you have the following skills and qualifications? At least 7 years of relevant experience in tax, fiscal, regulatory and compliance matters. A degree in Law or a tax-related field is mandatory. Strong knowledge of the Italian regulatory framework and legislative processes; knowledge of other Southern European markets is an advantage. Proven experience in stakeholder management, institutional relations and complex project management. Excellent analytical, organisational, communication and negotiation skills. Fluency in Italian and English. Flexibility to travel frequently within Italy, Greece, Croatia and Turkey. Working hours: Full-time, 40 hours weekly. Contract offer: Employment through a fixed-term temporary agency contract. Applicable collective agreement (CCNL): Commerce. Classification level: Level 1. Salary: €84,000-€86,000 gross per year (RAL). Work location: Milan or Rome, with regular travel to Milan required for candidates based in Rome, including overnight stays, and frequent business travel across Southern Europe. If you have the skills and experience required for this role, we look forward to receiving your application! title: consulente in energia solare
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e portare a mercato l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture, ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Responsabilità principali - Definire roadmap, posizionamento e 'pacchetti' dei servizi commerciali satellite-enabled. - Disegnare e lanciare offerte wholesale: modelli di partnership, livelli di servizio (SLA) e pricing. - Raccogliere esigenze da clienti/partner e tradurle in requisiti operativi e deliverable per i team coinvolti. - Identificare verticali prioritari, sviluppare opportunità commerciali e portare i pilot a contratti ricorrenti. - Selezionare e validare componenti e partner necessari all'erogazione del servizio (dispositivi/terminali e servizi di piattaforma/ground). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale #LI-CP Location: Milano, Italia (ibrido valutabile) Package: RAL 70-90K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio

title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Per potenziamento della funzione Acquisti tecnici a supporto dei plant, ricerchiamo un/una: Industrial Sr Buyer / Technical Procurement (CAPEX & MRO). La risorsa, riportando al Purchasing Manager, opererà trasversalmente sugli stabilimenti italiani con impatto diretto su continuità produttiva, governance della spesa tecnica e performance dei fornitori. Collaborerà quotidianamente con Engineering, Manutenzione e Plant Management, oltre che con Qualità/HSE, Finance e Legal. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. Principali responsabilità: Gestione end-to-end del sourcing su CAPEX, servizi tecnici e MRO: dal fabbisogno alla contrattualizzazione Impostazione e conduzione di RFQ/RFP e gare, con comparativi tecnico-economici e analisi TCO Negoziazione di condizioni commerciali e contratti (garanzie, penali, tempi di consegna, collaudi/accettazioni, ricambi e service) Definizione e gestione di accordi quadro e contratti di service con SLA/KPI, aumentando la copertura contrattuale della spesa ricorrente Vendor management: qualifica, monitoraggio performance, gestione criticità/claim, mitigazione rischi (lead time, single source, continuità assistenza) Supporto a Engineering/Manutenzione su standardizzazione, ricambistica critica e iniziative di miglioramento Competenze tecniche richieste: Diploma tecnico (Perito Meccanico/Meccatronico) e/o Laurea in Ingegneria (preferenza Meccanica/Meccatronica/Industriale) Esperienza indicativa 5-10+ anni in acquisti tecnico-industriali in contesti manifatturieri strutturati Esposizione concreta a CAPEX e contrattualistica service, oltre a categorie MRO (ricambi, consumabili, manutenzioni) Familiarità con tendering strutturato, logiche TCO e disciplina di processo Buona padronanza di ERP/strumenti di procurement Inglese fluente per negoziazione e gestione fornitori internazionali Competenze manageriali e soft skills: Negoziazione evoluta e capacità di gestire trade-off costo/qualità/rischio/continuità Autorevolezza con stakeholder tecnici, forte orientamento all'execution e gestione priorità in contesto produttivo Comunicazione sintetica e capacità di escalation strutturata Approccio data-driven, rigore e affidabilità Sede di lavoro: Italia, area Emilia-Romagna, con trasferte prevalentemente nazionali e, in funzione dei progetti, internazionali. Attività prevalentemente on site. Offerta: inserimento a tempo indeterminato. Package indicativo: RAL €45.000-€55.000 + MBO ~10%. title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: QiBIT, divisione ICT di Gi Group S.p.A., Agenzia per il Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), è specializzata nella selezione, formazione, inserimento e sviluppo professionale dei profili IT per il mercato italiano. Per A2A Smart City, Società del Gruppo A2A che sviluppa progetti per città intelligenti, clienti Business e società del Gruppo, investendo nell'innovazione tecnologica, QiBIT ricerca un/una: TECNICO DI MANUTENZIONE - RETI TLC La persona selezionata verrà inserita all'interno del team 'TLC ASSURANCE & MAINTENANCE'. La struttura ha la responsabilità di garantire l'esercizio e la manutenzione della rete e degli apparati di A2A Smart City e dei suoi clienti. Ti occuperai di: Gestione dei ticket di Incident e Change e troubleshooting su apparati di rete (router, switch, access point) Esecuzione di interventi tecnici on-site e sopralluoghi presso impianti attivi per la diagnosi e la risoluzione di guasti e malfunzionamenti Gestione della documentazione relativa alla sicurezza di cantiere (DUVRI, POS, PSC e documenti correlati) Coordinamento di fornitori, partner e squadre operative esterne, monitorando il rispetto di tempi, standard qualitativi e requisiti di sicurezza Verifica della conformità degli impianti alle specifiche progettuali, gestione dei collaudi e della chiusura lavori, con controllo della contabilità delle imprese esecutrici Sei la persona giusta se ti riconosci in questo profilo: Diploma tecnico in ambito Elettronica, Elettrotecnica, Informatica, Telecomunicazioni Circa 2-3 anni di esperienza in ruoli affini nel settore Telecomunicazioni, System Integrator o Internet Service Provider Conoscenza delle reti di telecomunicazione e dei principali protocolli di comunicazione (TCP/IP, VoIP, LTE) Competenze su architetture e protocolli di rete, padronanza dei sistemi di monitoraggio e trouble ticketing per la risoluzione dei guasti Conoscenze linguistiche Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Patente di guida B Disponibilità a reperibilità, sopralluoghi e trasferte sul territorio nazionale Rappresenta un plus: possesso di certificazioni di settore quali CCNA, HCNA o JNCIA Completano il profilo: orientamento al lavoro di squadra, flessibilità, approccio collaborativo, concretezza, capacità di problem solving, mindset analitico, attitudine alla pianificazione ed organizzazione del lavoro. Che cosa offriamo - Qualifica: Impiegato/a - Contratto Collettivo Nazionale settore Elettrico - Disciplina Speciale - Retribuzione: è prevista una Retribuzione Annua Lorda tra 31.000€ e 36.000€ - Premio di risultato aziendale, con la possibilità, a discrezione del dipendente, di conversione in welfare o trasferibile al fondo di pensione integrativa con un contributo aggiuntivo da parte dell'azienda. - Straordinari Retribuiti - Indennità di reperibilità - Performance Management: partecipazione al processo di Performance Management in ottica di miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni e con focus sulla crescita delle persone, grazie a feedback anche da persone diverse dal proprio manager, alla possibilità di indicare le proprie aspettative per il futuro e all'identificazione di Azioni di Sviluppo - Pasti: Ristorazione aziendale e/o buoni pasto elettronici in base alla sede di inserimento - Flessibilità: settimana lavorativa con venerdì a orario ridotto, flessibilità entrata/uscita e pausa pranzo - Smartworking sino al 40% dell'orario di lavoro su base bimestrale Sede di lavoro: Bergamo Gi Group S.p.A. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro (Aut. Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). title: Database and network professionals
description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Principali responsabilità - Supportare le attività di prevendita tecnica nell'ambito di gare, offerte e opportunità - commerciali in tecnologia multivendor. - Analizzare i requisiti tecnici e di business dei clienti. - Definire architetture e soluzioni infrastrutturali in ambito Networking e Data Center. - Predisporre documentazione tecnica, High Level Design, allegati di gara e documenti di - offerta. - Collaborare alla definizione della soluzione economica e alla stima degli effort progettuali. - Interfacciarsi con vendor e distributori. - Supportare PoC, workshop, demo e presentazioni tecniche. - Collaborare con Delivery e Operation. - Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta aziendale. - Supportare il coordinamento tecnico di offerte complesse. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. Sede di Lavoro: Milano CCNL Metalmeccanico, Livello B3 O Quadro A1 RALT (fisso + variabile): 70.000€ SW fino al 50%, Ticket da 9 euro. Possibilità di auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l'impegno di sostenere l'inclusività e la diversity. Invitiamo a sottoporre le candidature evitando di fornire informazioni relative a matrimonio, gravidanza, responsabilità familiari, stato di famiglia. #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive.
