title: Fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery
description: Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgiVi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!Program DescriptionThe department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers a 6-month fellowship in reconstructive microsurgery. Uppsala is one of the more active units in reconstructive microsurgery in northern Europe with a case load consisting of more than 120 free flaps, 50 complex non microvascular cases in the areas of head and neck reconstruction, breast reconstruction, facial paralysis, lower extremity and complex wound care and more than 50 lymphaticovenous operations per year. The free flap service includes head and neck reconstructions, lower extremity, facial palsy, breast and lymphoedema. The fellowship program is endorsed by the Swedish Society for Reconstructive Microsurgery.Fellowship ResponsibilitiesThe fellow will work in a team of specialists and residents and will participate in the planning and execution of the reconstructive cases performed by the team. The fellow will participate in all teaching activities in the department and will be responsible for around one monthly presentation.The fellow is required to undertake one research project within microsurgery and is expected to finish one publication.SalaryCompetitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.RequirementsThe candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or finish a training program in plastic surgery and have an ambition to pursue a career in reconstructive microsurgery and be able to work in a team.How to applySubmit your CV and two letters of recommendation.ContactAndres Rodriguez, andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se (andres.rodriguez.lorenzo@akademiska.se)Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95Vill du jobba med oss?Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Sub-regional Procurement Category Manager
description: Great procurement goes beyond negotiating a better price. It connects business needs, supplier expertise and market insight to create lasting value. Ready to put that into practice across an international manufacturing business?At DS Smith, we are looking for a Sub-Regional Procurement Category Manager to develop and implement procurement strategies across manufacturing, commodities and pallets in North & East EMEA. You will help shape a competitive and sustainable supply base that supports our packaging operations, innovation and business growth.About the roleYou will shape and deliver procurement strategies for manufacturing, commodities and pallets across North & East EMEA. Reporting to the Sub-Regional Procurement Lead East & North EMEA, you will work with local and global procurement colleagues, Operations and Engineering to lead sourcing, negotiations and supplier partnerships across manufacturing inputs, maintenance services and capital equipment.Combining international category responsibility with practical impact at site level, you will improve cost, working capital, supplier performance and resilience while supporting innovation and sustainability. This is an opportunity to influence how we source the materials, equipment and services our manufacturing sites rely on.The role will be based at one of our offices or sites in Sweden or Denmark, with travel of up to 30%. Posible locations: Värnamo, Mariestad or Gothenburg, in Sverige; Grenaa or Taastrup, in Denmark.About youYou bring procurement category management experience within manufacturing or packaging, including category strategy, complex sourcing and negotiations. Commercially minded and analytical, you turn market insight into practical solutions and build strong relationships across functions and countries to deliver results.You have a bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification and are fluent in English as well as Swedish or Danish. Experience with SAP and Coupa, additional European languages, and CIPS or an equivalent procurement qualification would be advantageous.About usDS Smith is a leading provider of sustainable fiber-based packaging worldwide, which is supported by recycling and papermaking operations. We play a central role in the value chain across sectors including e-commerce, fast moving consumer goods and industrials. Through our purpose of ‘Redefining Packaging for a Changing World’ and our Now and Next sustainability strategy, DS Smith is committed to leading the transition to the circular economy. We are delivering more and more circular solutions for our customers and wider society – replacing problem plastics, taking carbon out of supply chains and providing innovative recycling solutions. Our history can be traced back to the box-making businesses started in the 1940s by the Smith family. Today, DS Smith is headquartered in London and a member of the FTSE 100, operating in 34 countries employing around 30,000 people.Your future workplaceDS Smith is focusing on realizing the potential of our people every day, and you will get close to endless opportunities for independent prioritization of your day-to-day work in a good work environment with colleagues of all ages and nationalities. Like all other DS Smith colleagues, we are proud of the opportunity to make a sustainable difference in a market-leading company. But we also consider our colleagues as individuals and would like to make their lives healthier and happier, therefore we offer our colleagues a range of benefits.Fair recruitment in DS SmithDon’t meet every single requirement? At DS Smith, we are committed to recruiting across a wide range of candidates. We are thriving for being a diverse workplace where everyone can realize their potential. We see equality and diversity as a strength. Thus, we hope that you will apply for the position even if you do not necessarily meet all the requirements.Would you like to know more?This full-time position can be based at one of our sites in either Sweden or Denmark, with travels between sites to be expected. Accession as soon as possible.If you want to know more about this role, contact our Head of Procurement Leader East & North EMEA, Jeremy Freyne: jeremy.freyne@dssmith.comIf you have questions regarding the process or trouble applying, please reach out to us at nordic.recruitment@dssmith.comWe hope to receive your application as soon as possible and no later than November 29th. Please observe that we do not accept applications by email.After having submitted your application, you may be expected to perform work psychological tests as well as respond to screening questions, as part of our objective, unbiased, and largely digital process.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Försöksledare/Parkchef
description: Enheten för skoglig fältforskningVill du ha en nyckelroll där du leder ett engagerat team och bidrar till framtidens skogsforskning? Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta utomhus i storslagen natur och vara med och utveckla banbrytande projekt inom skogliga ekosystem- och klimatfrågor.Vi söker en praktiker med forskningserfarenhet och goda ledaregenskaper som vill leda verksamheten vid Siljansfors och Jädraås försöksparker, liksom att ingå i ledningsgruppen för hela Enheten för skoglig fältforskning. Arbetet erbjuder stora möjligheter för dig som tycker om varierade arbetsuppgifter, stimuleras av utmaningar och vill bidra till boreal skogsproduktionsforskning och ekosystemforskning.Under 2024 gjorde Enheten en översyn av sin strategiska verksamhetsplan fram t.o.m. 2030, vilket resulterade i ett delvis förändrat sätt att organisera arbetet som nyss har implementerats. Tillsammans med fakultetens ambition att bredda verksamheten pågår det en successiv utökning av verksamhetsuppdraget. Det ställer krav på en enhetsgemensam och funktionell organisation med utgångspunkt från verksamhetens huvudområden långtidsförsök, större infrastrukturer, uppdragsprojekt respektive miljöanalys.Om jobbetDu ingår i Enhetens ledningsgrupp och som parkchef för Siljansfors och Jädraås försöksparker har du ett helhetsansvar för verksamheten inom det egna ansvarsområdet (Svealand och södra Norrland), vilket omfattar ekonomiskt ansvar för verksamheten och personalansvar inklusive arbetsmiljöfrågor. Din uppgift är att se till att parkens verksamhet, inom givna ekonomiska ramar, utvecklas på ett gynnsamt sätt för fältforskning, miljöövervakning och undervisning. SLU-intern samverkan och samverkan med det omgivande samhället är också områden som en parkchef kontinuerligt arbetar med.Arbetet som parkchef innebär att du tillsammans med dina medarbetare ser till att aktuella skogliga fältförsök underhålls och revideras enligt plan och med hjälp av modern teknik, samt att nya försök för framtida forskningsfrågor anläggs redan idag. Du ansvarar för innehållet i metadatabaser och databaser kopplade till dem. Som parkchef ansvarar du för att försöksparkens team aktivt deltar i styrgrupperna för verksamhetens olika huvudområden och att de arbetsuppgifter som grupperna beslutar om implementeras inom ditt ansvarsområde. Att ta emot förfrågningar och i möjligaste mån genomföra dem, gällande anläggning eller revision av skogliga fältförsök, miljöövervakningsuppdrag, liksom undervisnings- och fortbildningsuppdrag, är en viktig del av arbetet.Under barmarksperioden kommer du att medverka i praktiskt arbete, vilket innebär en hel del utomhusvistelse och resande under kortare perioder.Din bakgrund Krav:    Högre skoglig utbildning, med forskarutbildning eller annan relevant erfarenhet av akademiskt arbete med god insikt i forskningens förutsättningar    Stor erfarenhet av praktiskt fältarbete i skogliga miljöer    God förmåga att strukturera arbetet och kan agera både pedagogiskt och diplomatiskt    B-körkort för bil    God kunskap i det svenska och engelska språketKvalifikationer som är meriterande:    Chefserfarenhet med personalansvar    Erfarenhet av praktiskt skogsbruk och skoglig inventering    Erfarenhet av databasarbete, GIS-data och relaterad mjukvara    Insatt i metodik och teknik för trädmätning och fältdatainsamling    Erfarenhet av meteorologiska instrument och dataloggrarVi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Av särskilt stor betydelse är förmågan att hantera oväntade situationer, t.ex. när nya arbetsuppgifter ska utföras med kort varsel. Tjänsten är placerad vid Siljansfors försöksparks kontor inne i Mora och vid fältstationen i Siljansfors, 18 km SV om Mora. Fakulteten för skogsvetenskap vid SLU finns i Umeå.Om tjänsten: Din tjänstetitel är försöksledare, där uppdraget som parkchef ingår. Överlämningen av detta uppdrag sker vid en tidpunkt som du, nuvarande parkchef och enhetsföreståndaren kommer överens omOm ossSLU disponerar åtta skogliga försöksparker i olika delar av Sverige. Försöksparkerna utgör tillsammans Enheten för skoglig fältforskning som ansvarar för SLU:s skogliga fältforskningsinfrastruktur, i vilken det även ingår ett stort antal långsiktiga fältförsök lokaliserade hos olika markvärdar utanför parkgränserna. Siljansfors försökspark är belägen ca 18 km SV om Mora i Dalarnas län och innefattar 1600 hektar skogsmark, Jädraås försökspark är belägen ca 40 km norr om Sandviken i Gävleborgs län. Flera nationella och internationella forsknings- och miljöövervakningsprojekt har förlagt infrastruktur och mätprogram på en eller flera av enhetens försöksparker.Mer information om enheten: https://www.slu.se/om-slu/organisation/institutioner/skoglig-faltforskning/ Läs mer om våra förmåner och hur det är att jobba vid SLU på https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/Placering:Siljansfors försöksparkAnställningsform:Tillsvidareanställning. SLU kan komma att tillämpa provanställning.Omfattning:100%Tillträde:1 februari eller enligt överenskommelse.Ansökan:Välkommen med din ansökan via ansökningsknappen nedan senast 2026-12-21Den 20–22 november går det inte att skicka in ansökningar via rekryteringssystemet på grund av en systemuppdatering.Fackliga kontaktpersoner:https://internt.slu.se/min-anstallning/facket/kontaktpersoner/ Sveriges lantbruksuniversitet (SLU) har en nyckelroll i utvecklingen för hållbart liv, grundad i vetenskap och utbildning. Genom vårt fokus på samspelen mellan människa, djur och ekosystem och ett ansvarsfullt brukande av naturresurserna bidrar vi till en hållbar samhällsutveckling och goda livsvillkor på vår planet. Huvudorter är Alnarp, Umeå och Uppsala, men verksamhet bedrivs också på forskningsstationer, försöksparker och utbildningsorter i hela landet. SLU har drygt 4000 medarbetare, 6000 studenter och forskarstuderande och en omsättning på över 4,5 miljarder kronor. Universitetet satsar på attraktiva miljöer på sina campusområden. Vi arbetar för en jämställd och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika erfarenheter lägger grunden för vetenskaplighet, kreativitet och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och perspektiv att söka den aktuella anställningen.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Company DescriptionEveryone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.But where does that take you?To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 12 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.And there’s more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.Job DescriptionWe are looking for a Senior Software Engineer(unlimited, full-time) to join our team located in StockholmIn this role, you will be a software development expert in an agile product development team, building and maintaining Riverty's Customer Identity Platform.The Customer Identity Platform enables millions of consumers to securely use Riverty products, while providing seamless technical integration and frictionless user experience. title: Postdoc in Environmental Change
description: We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application! Are you interested in the potential of citizens' assemblies and other democratic innovations to drive climate transformation? Come join us!Work assignments The Environmental Change division (tema Miljöförändring) at the Department of Thematic Studies is looking to hire a two-year postdoctoral researcher specializing in democratic innovations.You will be part of the Formas-funded research project Democratic Innovations for Climate Transformation (2027-2029), which entails a systematic and interdisciplinary knowledge synthesis of how climate citizens’ assemblies and related democratic processes can contribute to system transformation. The project explores what the existing research literature tells us about the political impact of climate assemblies, how they might contribute to broader systemic transformations, and what this means for Swedish climate governance.As postdoc on the project, you will take a leading role in carrying out the systematic literature review across academic databases and grey literature, following established standards for searching, screening, and quality assessment. You will contribute centrally to the comparative synthesis of findings across studies, and to identifying evidence gaps in how deliberative processes connect to system-level transformation. You will also help design and facilitate stakeholder dialogues with Swedish municipalities and practitioners, which ensures that the resulting knowledge is robust and genuinely useful for policy and practice.You will work in close collaboration with the project’s principal investigator and a research team from LiU and Stockholm Resilience Centre. There is considerable room to help shape the project’s methodological choices and analytical framework, and to co-author academic outputs arising from the review and synthesis work.As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.QualificationsTo be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.Your doctoral degree should preferably have been awarded no more than three years ago. If there are special reasons, a degree awarded more than three years ago may be accepted. Special reasons include sick leave, parental leave, trade union positions of trust, service in the defense, or other similar circumstances, as well as service or assignments relevant to the subject area.We are looking for someone with a doctoral degree in social sciences, humanities, or related fields, and a demonstrated familiarity with the research area of democratic innovations – for example, deliberative democracy, citizens’ assemblies, participatory governance, or environmental/climate governance. Experience carrying out systematic literature reviews and others forms of qualitative content analysis is considered a merit. So is prior experience with stakeholder involvement and co-production through workshops and similar formats.You are curious, rigorous, and comfortable moving between the fine-grained work of systematic screening and coding and the bigger-picture task of synthesizing what it all means. You enjoy working collaboratively, taking initiative, and are able to communicate complex research to non-academic audiences, such as policymakers and practitioners. A strong command of written and spoken English is required.The workplaceYou will be employed at the Department of Thematic Studies where you will be affiliated with the Environmental Change theme. You can read about the workplace https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/tema/temam.The employmentThis employment is a temporary full-time contract of two years. Starting date is Januari 1, 2027, or as soon as possible. Salary and employment benefitsAt Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.Union representativesInformation about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.Application procedureApply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 27 November, 2026.Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application. Please note that printed publications will not be returned. They will be archived at Linköping University. In the event of a discrepancy between the English translation of the job announcement and the Swedish original, the Swedish version shall take precedent. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.We look forward to receiving your application! Linköping university has framework agreements and wishes to decline direct contacts from staffing- and recruitment companies as well as vendors of job advertisements.

title: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
description: Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:    Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.    Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.    Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.Required qualificationsThe position requires:    PhD in Biology or Bioengineering    Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories    At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal     Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels    Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification    Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.    Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D    Experience in microfluidics and microscopy    Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD    Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).Merits include:    Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation    Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.    Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software    Experience as executive member of scientific societies Terms of employmentThis is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.Application instructionsYour application should include:    A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans    A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors    A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)    A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)We warmly welcome your application!Mer om Medicinska fakultetenMedicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

title: PhD Student in Urban Water Engineering
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.The Urban Water Engineering research group at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural resources engineering at Luleå University of Technology seeks a driven and committed PhD student to investigate how smart monitoring and predictive modelling can support more effective and environmentally sustainable maintenance of urban drainage infrastructure. The research focuses on understanding sediment accumulation through sensor-based monitoring and data analysis, contributing to improved water quality and urban flood resilience. More information on http://www.ltu.se/waterSubject descriptionUrban Water Engineering encompasses the entire urban water system (storm drains, drinking water supply and wastewater) with respect to collection, transport and treatment, as well as organisation and planning. The research aims to encourage a strong economy, clean environment and the wise use of resources, while preserving the public’s health and safety.Project descriptionStormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.The PhD research will focus on developing a data-driven understanding of sediment accumulation processes in urban drainage infrastructures. This includes long-term monitoring using high-resolution sensors to capture sediment dynamics across rainfall events and seasons. Based on these data, predictive models will be developed to estimate sediment accumulation and infrastructure’s remaining functionality. The results will support more effective maintenance strategies by identifying when and where maintenances are needed to maximise environmental performance and operational efficiency.Within this project, the doctoral student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in the water and wastewater industry and will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers through LTU's well-established competence network.DutiesAs a PhD student, you will perform both experimental and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse scientific data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work. The research work for this project will specifically include experimental work.QualificationsWe seek a candidate with an MSc degree or equivalent or fully completed course requirements of at least 240 ETCS of which at least 60 ETCS are at an advanced level or equivalent. The degree should be within the field of water and environment, environmental engineering, natural resources engineering, civil engineering, or equivalent. Specific knowledge of stormwater management, hydraulics/hydrology, statistics, machine learning, thermodynamics (e.g. heat transfer processes) and programming, as well as experience of sensor-based monitoring, are meritorious. Other important skills are the ability to work independently and take initiative, as well as being able to explore new research areas.English language skills are required since the results will be presented internationally in scientific journals and at conferences. Swedish/Scandinavian language skills are beneficial, as they will facilitate communication with stakeholders and participation in teaching activities. Having a driver’s license is meritorious, as it will facilitate research work.Applicants should provide contact details to minimum two reference persons upon request.For further information about a specific subject see:* http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=enFurther informationEmployment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added to that time with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: Spring 2027.For each position, a preliminary is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role. https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-InformationonpaytransparencyFor further information about the position, please contact Postdoctoral researcherHaoyu Wei, 0920-491728, haoyu.wei@ltu.seUnion representatives: https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-TradeunioncontactsIn case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.ApplicationWe prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.Closing date for applications: 30 November 2026Reference number: 5719-2026

title: CLEANING SUPERVISOR  HOSTEL

title: HR Operations Specialist EMEA
description: At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.HR Operations Specialist EMEAWe are looking for a colleague that will be responsible for delivering efficient, compliant,  HR operations across multiple countries within the EMEA region. This role serves as a key liaison between managers, employees, functional HR Business Partners, external payroll providers, and benefit vendors to ensure seamless execution of payroll, benefits, HR administration, and HR systems processes.You will play a critical role in maintaining operational excellence, driving process improvements, and providing subject matter expertise across all aspects of HR operations.You will be a part of the HR Operations team, reporting to Head of Total Rewards and be situated in Gothenburg in Sweden or Valencia in Spain.Key responsibilities:- Delivering accurate and compliant payroll and benefits administration across all assigned  countries- Maintaining high-quality employee data and HR process integrity- Manage HR administration throughout the employee lifecycle- Ensure that HR Operational processes comply with local labor laws and company policies- Independently drive and take ownership of your scope  To be successful in this position you would need:· Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or Finance or relevant working experience· 7+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Administration, Payroll or Shared Services· Demonstrated experience supporting multiple countries across EMEA· Strong international HR operations experience, exceptional attention to detail,  and the ability to manage complex processes across multiple countries and vendors.· Solid understanding of employee benefits, pensions and insurance programs· Experience working with HRIS platforms such as Sage, HiBob, Workday or similar systems· Strong experience managing outsourced payroll providers· Good communication and collaboration skills· Fluent in English and Swedish or Spanish, verbally and in writingPreferred start date Mid-January 2027.Interviews will be conducted continuously, and the position might be filled before last application date.We look forward to receiving your application!Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Health care assistant
description: Location: Primarily based in Genolier, Switzerland, with occasional travel to the United Kingdom (approximately 5 to 10 days per calendar year, based on current information).Working schedule: Rotational shifts of approximately 14–16 daysWorking environment: Private householdConsistent Care Team provisionThe Care Team shall ultimately comprise 3 members of staff: 1 Registered Nurse and 2 Health Care Assistants/Carers.The Registered Nurse will have day-to-day oversight of the Care Team and clinical decision making and assessment delegating tasks and roles to the 2-care staff, one member of the team shall be allocated to care of the principal. This should be consistent for the length of rotation.The general purpose:To provide discreet, reliable and familiar support while protecting independence, routines and quality of life.The general proposed arrangement:Dedicated member of staff would work complementary rotations of approximately 14 to 16 days. This creates continuity, familiarity and a clear handover between people who understand the Principal preferences, schedule and day-to-day needs.Person Specifications:• Calm, knowledgeable and confident.• Excellent personal skills.• Min 5 years’ experience of older adult care with and without dementia diagnosis or cognitive impairment.• An experience within a private household would be appreciated.• Full UK driving license and willingness to drive in Switzerland.• Ability to travel to Switzerland and UK for periods of time: if not UK based then work permit will be required for UK / if not Switzerland based then work permit will be required for Switzerland.• English as first language or excellent written and verbal English skills.Coverage:• Two suitably qualified care staff working alternating 14 to 16-day rotations.• Continuity of support with one primary point of care available throughout each rotation.Daily routine (sample):Join principal for twice daily dog walks, support normal routines and remain attentive to day-to-day wellbeing. This will include driving duties for the principal to and from the sites of dog walks and on lunch outings.Care should fit around Principal’s life, requests and preferences, allowing the Principal to remain active, involved and in control. Presence should be discrete and unobtrusive, however being available and visible to Principal for reassurance.English as a first language is preferred, however consideration to those with an excellent grasp of spoken and written English will be considered.Health supportRespond appropriately to concerns within scope of practice as per professional regulations and/or registration, monitor changes and escalate to the relevant clinician ie Registered Nurse in the first instance, GP or emergency services when required.Assistance with personal care may be required, currently minimal prompting and support.Confidently reassuring Principal and providing information relevant to the needs.Medical appointmentsAccompany principal to appointments, take accurate notes and relay agreed information to the family and team.Clearer communication, better continuity and less risk of important information being lost.Team responsibilityAct as the defined first point of contact for day-to-day care matters, within clear professional boundaries.Removes medical responsibility from the wider household and business team.Family confidenceCommunicating with family and supporting peace of mind that high-quality care is present without making home life feel clinical.

Comfortable using AI tools such as Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT, with a genuine interest in automation and efficiency. Fluent German (written and spoken) is mandatory. Experience with Swiss and European accounting practices, particularly Germany. Proven knowledge of statutory financial statements, VAT and Intrastat reporting. Organized, resilient and able to prioritize in a complex environment. Positive, proactive and solution\\-oriented mindset aligned with Laurastar values. bereit, regelmässig an unsere Standorte in der Ostschweiz zu reisen.**Dein Lohn****Deine Kontaktpersonen**Sam Eftekhari\-ShahabLeiter Service und Support ICTLydia InauenHR Business Partner**Über uns**Mit rund 1'400 Mitarbeitenden stellen wir an unseren neun Unternehmensstandorten gut zugängliche, persönliche und wirkungsvolle psychiatrische Behandlungen und die Betreuung von erwachsenen Menschen in den Kantonen und Appenzell Ausserrhoden sowie im Fürstentum Liechtenstein sicher.**Bewerbungsprozess****Online bewerben**  Wir sind digital unterwegs und setzen uns für Nachhaltigkeit ein, daher freuen wir uns auf deine Online\-Bewerbung über unsere Homepage.**Bestätigung per E\-Mail**  Sobald deine Bewerbung online bei uns eingegangen ist, bekommst du eine Empfangsbestätigung per E\-Mail zugestellt. Wir freuen uns, dich anhand deines Dossiers kennenzulernen und prüfen, ob deine Qualifikationen, Fähigkeiten und du als Person zur ausgeschriebenen Stelle und zur Psychiatrie passen. Danach melden wir uns bei dir. **Vorstellungsgespräch mit HR und Fachbereich**  Bei einem persönlichen Gespräch lernen wir uns kennen und du erfährst mehr über die Psychiatrie , die ausgeschriebene Stelle und die Herausforderungen.**Einladung zum zweiten Gespräch**  In der zweiten Runde möchten wir uns gerne ein noch besseres Bild von Ihnen machen und gemeinsam mit Ihnen herausfinden, ob wir zusammenpassen. Zudem erhalten Sie die Möglichkeit, Ihr künftiges Team kennenzulernen.**Mündliche Zusage**  Sie erhalten von uns eine telefonische Zusage, wenn wir uns nach dem zweiten Gespräch für Sie entscheiden und fragen bei Ihnen nach, ob auch Sie weiterhin von uns überzeugt sind. Wenn wir uns einig sind, erstellen wir Ihren Vertrag.**Der Vetrag**  In den darauffolgenden Tagen senden wir Ihnen per Post den Vertrag im Doppel zu. Mit dem Vertrag erhalten Sie auch relevante Informationen zu Ihrer Anstellung.**Preboarding**  Zwischen der Annahme der Stelle und dem ersten Arbeitstag können Sie als neue Mitarbeiterin oder neuer Mitarbeiter bereits auf relevante interne Informationen zugreifen. So können Sie sich ein differenziertes Bild des Unternehmens machen und sich bereits auf den Job vorbereiten.**Erster Arbeitstag**  Am ersten Tag erwartet Sie ein Onboarding in Ihrem neuen Team und mit weiteren Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Sie richten sich am neuen Arbeitsplatz ein und schaffen sich einen Überblick über Ihre nächsten Aufgaben. title: Electricien de Maintenance
description: Ref 2590049 \| Date: 9 Nov 2026![R. Montavon SA]( )Avec plus de 60 ans d’expérience et d’innovation dans le domaine du saphir et de l’injection plastique, nous avons acquis et développé un savoir\-faire unique et complémentaire dans la réalisation de pièces sur mesure. Ces compétences répondent aux exigences de nos clients aussi bien au niveau technique qu’esthétique.Afin de renforcer notre Département **« Maintenance** **»**, nous recherchons un :**Electricien de Maintenance (H/F)****Missions :*** Réaliser les travaux de maintenance préventive, corrective et curative des machines conventionnelles, automatisées et à commande numérique pour les secteurs saphir et plasturgie ;* Assurer la disponibilité, la fiabilité et la sécurité électrique des équipements de production ;* Contribuer à l’amélioration des équipements afin de garantir la continuité de production et la qualité des produits, en collaboration avec les équipes techniques et de production.**Responsabilités :*** Diagnostiquer les pannes électriques et les dysfonctionnements des systèmes de commande afin de rétablir la production ;* Construction et/ou modification électriques des installations de production* Appliquer les procédures de consignation et les règles de sécurité dans les limites de ses compétences et autorisations ;* Contrôler le fonctionnement des équipements et des dispositifs de sécurité avant leur remise à disposition de la production ;* Analyser les pannes récurrentes et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à fiabiliser les équipements ;* Participer aux déménagements des machines et à l’installation, la mise en service et la modernisation des moyens de production ;* Organiser ses interventions avec la production et les autres intervenants de maintenance selon les priorités définies ;* Documenter les interventions et mettre à jour les schémas électriques et les dossiers techniques ;* Identifier les besoins en pièces de rechange et contribuer à la disponibilité des composants critiques* Accompagner les prestataires externes et transmettre aux équipes les bonnes pratiques d’utilisation et de surveillance des équipements ;* Veiller à la sécurité des personnes, au respect des consignes et au maintien en bon état des équipements.**Profil :*** CFC d’automaticien, d’électricien ou formation équivalente, avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience en maintenance de machines de production industrielle ;* Maîtrise du diagnostic électrique, des appareils de mesure et de la lecture des schémas électriques ;* Compétences en diagnostic sur automates et interfaces opérateur, avec des connaissances de base des commandes numériques et automates Fanuc, Siemens et Beckhoff ;* Bonne compréhension des systèmes de chauffe et de régulation de température, ainsi que des interactions électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et hydrauliques ;* Aisance avec les outils informatiques de maintenance et la documentation technique ; connaissances de base en anglais ;* Des connaissances en robotique (Stäubli, Universal Robots) et en vision industrielle (Cognex) constituent des atouts ;* Rigueur et sens des responsabilités en matière de sécurité ;* Esprit d’analyse et approche méthodique de la résolution de problèmes ;* Autonomie et fiabilité dans l’exécution des interventions ;* Capacité à collaborer avec les équipes de production et de maintenance ;* Sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les priorités ;* Réactivité et maîtrise de soi face aux arrêts de production ;* Esprit d’initiative, bonne communication et orientation vers des solutions durables.**Horaires de travail :** Service de piquet et 2x8 possible**Nous offrons :*** Vacances : 5 semaines par année \+ 1 semaine sur rattrapage ;* Pause de 15min offerte ;* Salaire versé sur 13 mois ;* Participation au paiement de votre caisse maladie ;* Evénements réguliers (repas d'été, brunchs mensuels, sorties d'entreprise, etc.) ;* Rabais chez différents partenaires (rabais flotte, ventes privées chez des marques prestigieuses, etc.) ;* Environnement de travail sain, valorisant, dynamique et en constante évolution.jpide363a2ajm jpit1146jm jpiy26jm

title: Référent Physiothérapeute   MotionLab - Genolier
description: Description de l'entreprise  Référent Physiothérapeute (H/F  Référent Physiothérapeute (H/F) MotionLab \- Genolier  Description de l'entreprise  Référent Physiothérapeute (H/F)  MotionLab \- Genolier  ðŸ“ Route du Muids 3, 1272 Genolier, Suisse  ðŸ•’ Temps complet (80 à 100 %)  ðŸ ¢ Département : MotionLab  ðŸ“… Entrée en fonction : à convenir  MotionLab : l'excellence en santé, rééducation et performance  Depuis 2019, MotionLab s'impose comme un centre de référence en Suisse dans les domaines de la santé, de la rééducation et de la performance sportive. Notre approche repose sur l'expertise clinique, l'innovation et la collaboration multidisciplinaire entre physiothérapeutes, médecins spécialistes et autres professionnels de la santé.  Intégré à Swiss Medical Network depuis 2024, MotionLab bénéficie d'un accès privilégié à l'un des plus importants réseaux de santé privés de Suisse.  Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités sur l'Arc lémanique, nous recherchons un(e) Responsable Physiothérapeute pour notre site de Genolier. Ce poste représente une opportunité unique de conjuguer une activité clinique de haut niveau avec des responsabilités de management, de développement stratégique et d'innovation au sein d'un environnement dynamique et en forte croissance.  Description du poste  En tant que Référent Physiothérapeute, vous assurez le pilotage des activités de physiothérapie du site de Genolier tout en participant activement à la prise en charge des patients.  Activités cliniques  Assurer la prise en charge de patients ambulatoires et hospitalisés.  Garantir un niveau d'excellence clinique et de qualité des soins.  Gérer des situations cliniques complexes et participer à l'élaboration des plans de traitement multidisciplinaires.  Développer des expertises spécialisées répondant aux besoins du réseau médical et des patients.  Assurer une coordination étroite avec les médecins, chirurgiens, ergothérapeutes et autres professionnels de santé.  Management et leadership  Encadrer, accompagner et développer l'équipe de physiothérapeutes du site.  Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la fidélisation des collaborateurs.  Favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif, motivant et orienté vers l'amélioration continue.  Organiser et coordonner l'activité afin d'assurer une prise en charge efficiente et de qualité.  Identifier les besoins en formation et soutenir le développement professionnel des équipes.  Développement de l'activité  Participer activement à la définition et à la mise en œuvre de la stratégie de développement de MotionLab Genolier.  Développer les collaborations avec les médecins spécialistes, les cliniques du groupe Swiss Medical Network et les partenaires externes.  Contribuer à la création de nouvelles prestations et parcours de soins innovants.  Promouvoir l'image et le positionnement de MotionLab dans la région.  Participer à des projets institutionnels visant à renforcer la qualité, l'efficience et la croissance de l'activité.  Qualité et innovation  Définir et faire évoluer les protocoles, standards et recommandations de prise en charge.  Garantir la qualité et la cohérence des traitements délivrés par l'équipe.  Suivre les indicateurs de performance et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des prestations.  Participer à l'intégration de nouvelles technologies et approches thérapeutiques innovantes.  Qualifications  Formation  Diplôme suisse de physiothérapeute ou titre reconnu par la Croix\-Rouge suisse.  CAS, DAS ou formation complémentaire en management, leadership ou gestion sont un atout.  Formation spécialisée dans un domaine clinique (sport, musculo\-squelettique, neurologie, pelvi\-périnéologie, réadaptation, thérapies manuelles, etc.) constitue un avantage.  Expérience  Expérience clinique confirmée en physiothérapie.  Première expérience d'encadrement ou fort intérêt pour les responsabilités managériales.  Expérience dans le développement d'activités ou de projets constitue un atout.  Compétences personnelles  Leadership naturel et capacité à fédérer une équipe.  Excellentes compétences relationnelles et communicationnelles.  Sens de l'organisation et de la gestion des priorités.  Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation résultats.  Autonomie, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités.  Intérêt marqué pour l'innovation, les nouvelles technologies et l'approche multidisciplinaire.  Volonté de contribuer activement au développement de MotionLab.  Informations supplémentaires  Nous offrons  Une fonction à responsabilités avec une réelle autonomie.  L'opportunité de participer au développement stratégique de MotionLab Genolier.  Un environnement multidisciplinaire d'excellence au sein de Swiss Medical Network.  Des possibilités de formation continue et de développement professionnel.  Des infrastructures modernes et des équipements de pointe.  Une équipe dynamique, engagée et tournée vers l'innovation.  La possibilité de contribuer activement à l'évolution des pratiques en physiothérapie et réadaptation.  Rejoignez MotionLab et participez au développement d'un centre de référence alliant excellence clinique, innovation et performance au service de nos patients. jpid07a48e6jm jpit0937jm jpiy26jm

Mit Professionalität, Fachkompetenz und echtem Gespür für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kundschaft sorgen wir dafür, dass jede Anfrage schnell, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert beantwortet wird. **Das bietet dir die Stelle*** Du bist täglich nah an unserer Kundschaft, telefonisch wie schriftlich. Hier hast du die Möglichkeit, echte Wirkung zu erzielen: Mit einem offenen Ohr, raschen Lösungen und einer persönlichen Note sorgst du dafür, dass sich unsere Kundschaft von Anfang an in guten Händen weiss* Du übernimmst eine zentrale koordinierende und gestaltest den Servicealltag aktiv mit. Du stimmst Termine mit der Kundschaft ab und planst die Einsätze und Tagestouren unserer Servicetechnikerinnen und Servicetechniker. Dabei hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum und kannst Abläufe aktiv mitgestalten* Du bist die Stimme, die unsere Kundschaft verlässlich begleitet. Du informierst proaktiv über Reparaturtermine und Montagen und schaffst damit Vertrauen, auch wenn noch keine definitive Lösung vorliegt* Du behältst in einem vielseitigen Alltag den Überblick. Pendente Aufträge und Statuslisten geben dir jederzeit ein klares Bild der und den Handlungsspielraum, dort anzupacken, wo es zählt **Das bringst du für die Stelle mit*** Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und bringst einige Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Tätigkeit mit. Ob Disposition, Contact Center oder Kundendienst, du kennst das Geschäft und weisst, worauf es ankommt* Im Kontakt mit der Kundschaft läufst du zur Hochform auf. Du kannst aus einem reichen Erfahrungsschatz im telefonischen Kundenkontakt schöpfen und findest auch in schwierigen Gesprächen den richtigen Ton* Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch und ösisch oder Italienisch – klar, professionell und partnerschaftlich. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein willkommenes Plus* Du bist eine aufgestellte, kommunikative Persönlichkeit und lässt dich auch in hektischen Momenten nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. Verbindlichkeit und eine positive Ausstrahlung sind für dich selbstverständlich* Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und mit hohem Organisationsgeschick. Du behältst mehrere Bälle gleichzeitig in der Luft und verlierst dabei nie den Überblick* Mit gängigen IT\-Systemen gehst du versiert um und bist offen, dein Wissen laufend zu erweitern **Noch nicht überzeugt? V\-ZUG bietet dir mehr als nur einen**Als Teil der V\-ZUG Familie profitierst du von zeitgemässen Anstellungsbedingungen, vielfältigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, modernster Infrastruktur sowie zahlreichen Angeboten und Dienstleistungen für dein persönliches Wohlbefinden. **Worauf wartest du noch?**Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!  Dossiers von Personalvermittlungen können wir für diese Vakanz nicht berücksichtigen. title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Technicien de maintenance électromécanique --- Technicien de maintenance électromécanique ============================================ \*\*Rejoignez un acteur clé de la micro\\-fabrication médicale\*\* --------------------------------------------------------------- Chez Resonetics, nous repoussons les limites de la micro\\-fabrication au service des dispositifs médicaux et du diagnostic. Nos technologies de pointe permettent à nos clients d'innover et d'améliorer la vie des patients à travers le monde. Notre site de Puidoux, qui compte 150 collaborateurs, est un fournisseur stratégique de tubes métalliques et composants de haute précision destinés aux appareils médicaux. Dans un contexte de croissance et d'exigence réglementaire forte, nous renforçons notre équipe qualité. Nous recherchons un \*\*technicien de maintenance électromécanique\*\* prêt à jouer un rôle clé dans la fiabilité et la performance de nos équipements, tout en assurant leur bon fonctionnement et en accompagnant nos équipes de production au quotidien. \*\*Mission\*\* ----------- Au sein de l'équipe de la Maintenance, vous assurez la maintenance préventive et corrective des équipements de production afin de garantir leur disponibilité, leur fiabilité et leur performance. Vous participez à l'ensemble des activités du service maintenance tout en apportant une expertise particulière en électricité industrielle et en diagnostic de pannes. \*\*Vos principales responsabilités\*\* ------------------------------------ \* Réaliser les opérations de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les équipements de production. \* Diagnostiquer et dépanner les pannes électriques, mécaniques, pneumatiques et électromécaniques. \* Assurer la remise en service des équipements dans le respect des exigences sécurité, qualité et production. \* Participer à la mise à jour de la documentation technique et des schémas électriques. \* Identifier les composants défectueux ou obsolètes et rechercher des solutions de remplacement adaptées. \* Collaborer avec les fournisseurs et accompagner les prestataires externes lors de leurs interventions. \* Participer aux actions d'amélioration continue visant à améliorer la fiabilité des équipements et à réduire les temps d'arrêt. \* Assurer la traçabilité des interventions dans la GMAO. \*\*Votre profil\*\* ---------------- \* CFC d'Automaticien ou formation technique équivalente avec expérience en maintenance industrielle. \* Minimum 5 ans d'expérience en maintenance industrielle, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé (ISO 13485 ou équivalent). \* Expérience du dépannage et de la maintenance sur des équipements industriels variés, y compris des équipements anciens. \* Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit. \* Solides connaissances en électricité industrielle et bonnes connaissances en mécanique industrielle et pneumatique. \* Connaissance d'une GMAO. \* Maîtrise de la lecture de schémas électriques et du diagnostic de pannes. \* Connaissances en automates industriels et interfaces opérateur constituant un atout. \* Autorisation OIBT art. 13 ou 15 constituant un atout. \* Personne autonome et pragmatique, dotée d'un fort esprit de terrain et d'une approche orientée vers la ein und stellst sicher, dass geplante Veränderungen mit den definierten Business\-Zielbildern übereinstimmen.* Du arbeitest eng mit Business\-Verantwortlichen, Enterprise und Domain Architecture, title: Internisten (m/w/d) für die umfassende Patientenversorgung in der Schweiz (Facharzt/-ärztin - Innere Medizin)
description: Für mehrere Regionen in der Schweiz suchen wir zur erweiterten Grundversorgung von Patienten mehrere Internisten und Internistinnen. Die Kliniken, für die wir aktiv suchen, engagieren sich nach neuestem Wissensstand in der Inneren Medizin.Indem sie sich mit anderen Gesundheitsexperten in der Schweiz vernetzen, ermöglichen sie eine umfassende und hochwirksame Versorgung. Man legt großen Wert auf medizinische Qualität und persönliche Behandlung. Dazu gehört, dass für jede Patientin und Patienten eine individuell abgestimmte Therapie ermöglicht wird. Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen alsInternistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.Zuständigkeiten / HauptaufgabenDie folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.- Umfassende Betreuung:Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.Qualifikationen / Anforderungen- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)StellungQualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-ZertifikatLeistungen der Anstellung- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag- Das Gehalt liegt bei ca. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung- Vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten- Landschaftlich reizvolle Arbeitsplätze zwischen Bergen und Seen- Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, diverse Angebote für Mitarbeiter, Work-Life-Balance- Sehr gute Familien und KinderbetreuungHilfe zum StartSie schätzen Herausforderungen, wollen neue Ziele erreichen und stellen sich gerne anspruchsvollen Aufgaben?Es erwartet Sie bei Ihrem neuen Arbeitsplatz ein engagiertes und motiviertes Team, dem Zuverlässigkeit und Respekt wichtig sind. description: ---base:  /meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead 100% (f/m/d)---SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead 100% (f/m/d)================================================Rieter is the world’s leading system supplier for processing natural and man\-made fibers into short\-staple and long\-staple yarn, as well as for the production of filament yarns, man\-made fibers and nonwovens. With its comprehensive technology portfolio, Rieter covers the entire textile value chain – from fiber to yarn, and from polymer melt to texturized filament, synthetic staple fibers and nonwoven. Headquartered in Winterthur, Switzerland, the company designs and engineers complex spinning plants, machines, systems, and components that enable an efficient and economical production. Rieter’s leading technologies ensure minimal resource consumption, making a significant contribution to sustainability across the global textile value chain. Rieter has a history spanning more than 230 years, operates 22 production sites in nine countries, and employs around 6 400 people worldwide, approximately 9% of them in Switzerland. Rieter is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange under the ticker symbol RIEN.We are seeking an experienced SAP Technical Service Delivery Lead to manage our enterprise SAP landscape, specialising in RISE with SAP, cloud transformation, and SAP technical operations. Proven track record in delivering high\-availability SAP S/4HANA environments, and leveraging SAP for Me for service transparency, incident management, and customer engagement. title: Software Engineer
employer: ETH Zürich CSCS - Swiss National Supercomputing Centre
description: Il datore di lavoro è alla ricerca di un/a:HPC Systems Software Engineer – OpenCHAMI for Lugano or Zürich (professione segnalata)Panoramica del progetto:Questo progetto, con sede di lavoro a Lugano o a Zurigo, si concentra sullo sviluppo e il potenziamento di OpenCHAMI per l’infrastruttura di supercalcolo di nuova generazione del CSCS. Il lavoro contribuirà alla creazione di un approccio aperto, scalabile e moderno alla gestione dei cluster per sistemi di calcolo ad alte prestazioni (HPC) su larga scala.L’obiettivo principale è progettare, sviluppare, integrare e implementare funzionalità di OpenCHAMI su misura per i requisiti operativi dei supercomputer del CSCS.Il progetto affronterà le sfide legate alla gestione di sistemi HPC e di intelligenza artificiale (AI) sempre più complessi e contribuirà all’evoluzione delle tecnologie open source di gestione dei cluster di nuova generazione.L’opportunità:Offriamo un contratto iniziale di due anni che ti darà l’opportunità di lavorare all’avanguardia nell’ambito delle infrastrutture HPC e di intelligenza artificiale presso il CSCS, contribuendo direttamente allo sviluppo di tecnologie che supporteranno i futuri sistemi di supercalcolo.Avrai l’opportunità di contribuire a OpenCHAMI e alle relative iniziative open source, collaborando con la più ampia comunità HPC e partecipando a programmi di grande impatto sia a livello nazionale che internazionale, tra cui HPSF, OpenCHAMI e iniziative correlate.Descrizione delle mansioni/del ruolo:Sviluppare e ampliare OpenCHAMI per soddisfare i requisiti operativi e di gestione dell’infrastruttura dei sistemi di supercalcolo attuali e di prossima generazione del CSCS.Contribuire all’ecosistema open source di OpenCHAMI, compresi lo sviluppo, l’integrazione e l’evoluzione dei servizi e dei componenti correlati alla gestione dei cluster.Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di automazione e gestione per migliorare il provisioning, la configurazione, il monitoraggio, la manutenzione e l’efficienza operativa dei sistemi su larga scala.Collaborare strettamente con i team operativi HPC per comprendere i requisiti e le sfide operative e tradurli in soluzioni basate su OpenCHAMI robuste, scalabili e di facile manutenzione.Contribuire all’architettura e all’evoluzione della piattaforma OpenCHAMI, garantendo che le soluzioni siano scalabili, affidabili, gestibili e allineate alle esigenze dei sistemi HPC e di IA su larga scala.Partecipare attivamente ai flussi di lavoro di sviluppo open source, tra cui la progettazione del software, l’implementazione, i test, le revisioni del codice, il tracciamento dei problemi e le discussioni tecniche all’interno della comunità OpenCHAMI.Collaborare con partner internazionali e con la più ampia comunità HPC per sviluppare e integrare soluzioni che promuovano la gestione dei cluster open source e l’automazione delle infrastrutture.Redigere e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica, inclusi progetti di architettura, guide all’implementazione, procedure operative e best practice.Valutare tecnologie e approcci emergenti rilevanti per la gestione delle infrastrutture HPC, l’osservabilità e l’automazione, e contribuire alla loro adozione ove opportuno.Il tuo profilo:Accogliamo con favore ingegneri con background diversi che siano desiderosi di contribuire alla nostra missione. Cerchiamo principalmente solide basi tecniche, un buon giudizio ingegneristico e la capacità di colmare le lacune tra i diversi ambiti. Curiosità, adattabilità, disponibilità ad apprendere sul campo e potenziale di crescita contano per noi più di una perfetta corrispondenza iniziale con i requisiti tecnici.Ambiente tecnico e aree di interesse:Linguaggio di programmazione GoGit e flussi di lavoro moderni per lo sviluppo softwarePipeline CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub, Ansible)Tecnologie di container (Docker, Podman)Sviluppo di software open sourceFramework di test, pratiche di qualità del software e approcci DevOps/GitOps_______________________________________________________________________________EinleitungstextThe Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates a high-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich.ProjekthintergrundProject Overview:This project with work location either Lugano or Zürich focuses on the development and advancement of OpenCHAMI for CSCS’s next-generation supercomputing infrastructure. The work will contribute to building an open, scalable, and modern approach to cluster management for large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) systems.The main objective is to design, develop, integrate, and deploy OpenCHAMI capabilities tailored to the operational requirements of CSCS supercomputers.The project will address the challenges of managing increasingly complex HPC and AI systems and contribute to the evolution of next-generation open-source cluster management technologies.What We Value:We value technical excellence, curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn and grow over a perfect checklist of skills. Working on next-generation HPC infrastructure requires a willingness to explore new technologies, tackle complex problems, and continuously develop new expertise.If you are motivated to make a meaningful impact in this area but do not meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply.The Opportunity:We offer an initially two-year contract providing the opportunity to work at the forefront of HPC and AI infrastructure at CSCS, contributing directly to the development of technologies that will support future supercomputing systems.You will have the opportunity to contribute to OpenCHAMI and related open-source initiatives, collaborating with the broader HPC community and contributing to high-impact programs at both the national and international levels, including HPSF, OpenCHAMI, and related initiatives.This is an opportunity to help shape how future CSCS supercomputers are managed, monitored, and operated, while contributing to open-source technologies with an impact well beyond a single system or institution.Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung Develop and extend OpenCHAMI to meet the infrastructure management and operational requirements of CSCS’s current and next-generation supercomputing systems.Contribute to the OpenCHAMI open-source ecosystem, including the development, integration, and evolution of related cluster management services and components.Develop automation and management workflows to improve system provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational efficiency at scale.Collaborate closely with HPC operations teams to understand operational requirements and challenges, and translate them into robust, scalable, and maintainable OpenCHAMI-based solutions.Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the OpenCHAMI platform, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with the needs of large-scale HPC and AI systems.Participate actively in open-source development workflows, including software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, issue tracking, and technical discussions within the OpenCHAMI community.Collaborate with international partners and the broader HPC community to develop and integrate solutions that advance open-source cluster management and infrastructure automation.Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture designs, implementation guides, operational procedures, and best practices.Evaluate emerging technologies and approaches relevant to HPC infrastructure management, observability, and automation, and contribute to their adoption where appropriate.Ihr ProfilWe welcome engineers with diverse backgrounds who are eager to contribute to our mission. We are primarily looking for strong technical foundations, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to bridge gaps across domains. Curiosity, adaptability,  willingness to learn on the job, and potential to growthmatter more to us than a perfect initial match of technical requirements.The technologies listed below illustrate the breadth of our stack and areas of interest. They are not a checklist of requirements, and experience in only some of these areas is expected.Technical environment and areas of interestGo programming languageGit and modern software development workflowsCI/CD pipelines (Gitlab, GitHub, Ansible)Container technologies (Docker, Podman)Open-source software developmentTesting frameworks, software quality practices, and DevOps/GitOps approachesPersonal qualities:Self-motivated, proactive, focused and collaborativeStrong problem-solving mindset and comfortable tackling complex or ambiguous problemsClear communicator with a strong sense of user needsOpen to learning new technologies and working across disciplinesComfortable asking for help and engaging the right expertise when neededWays of working:Ability to thrive in collaborative, self-organizing environments inspired by Agile principlesExperience with structured development practices such as test-driven development is a plusOur core values as guiding principles:Curiosity: You enjoy learning, exploring new ideas, and understanding problems deeply.Openness: You listen, collaborate, and are receptive to different perspectives.Courage: You tackle challenging or ambiguous problems and are willing to take initiative.Supportiveness: You help colleagues and users succeed and contribute to a positive team culture.Integrity: You act honestly, ethically, and reliably in your work.

title: Responsable des relevés et décomptes
description: Responsable des relevés et décomptes  Introduction  Nous donnons un avenir aux maisons. Nous le faisons avec des produits et services qui aident à réduire les émissions de CO2 des bâtiments. Pour ce faire, nous gérons des données et des processus permettant de rendre les propriétés plus écologiques, sûres et confortables. La base de nos produits et services est numérique. Nous veillons à faciliter la transition vers nos technologies durables pour tous. Ainsi, nous permettons à chaque personne de contribuer à la protection du climat.  Nous avons déjà déployé plus de 48 millions d'appareils connectés dans le monde et développons des solutions pour des bâtiments écoénergétiques et résilients. Nous employons plus de 6 600 personnes dans 21 pays et nos produits et services sont utilisés dans plus de 14 millions de logements et bâtiments commerciaux dans le monde, chez plus de 460 000 clients. En 2025, le groupe ista élargi a généré un chiffre d'affaires de 1'287 millions d'euros.  Pour renforcer notre équipe en Suisse, nous recherchons un·e Responsable des relevés et décomptes motivé·e et engagé·e.  Ce qui t'attend chez nous  En tant que Responsable du suivi administratif et de la gestion des consommations, tu joueras un rôle essentiel dans notre structure. Tes missions principales:  Calcul des consommations: Tu analyses les relevés de consommation et établis les décomptes individuels de chauffage et d’eau chaude destinés aux propriétaires, gérances et locataires.  Relation client: Tu es en contact direct avec nos clients et tu assures un accueil téléphonique de qualité.  Collaboration: Tu travailles de ère autonome tout en coordonnant avec les gérances et/ou les propriétaires.  Polyvalence: Tu prends part à d’autres tâches administratives selon les besoins.  Ce poste est fait pour toi si :  Tu es titulaire d’un CFC d’employé(e) de commerce.  Tu as plusieurs années d’expérience en comptabilité immobilière, notamment réalisation de décomptes de frais de chauffages et frais accessoires.  Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se) et autonome.  Tu aimes les chiffres et tu sais traiter les données avec précision.  Tu sais gérer une charge de travail importante sans compromettre la qualité.  Tu as le sens du service client.  Tu apprécies les contacts avec de nombreux interlocuteurs et gardes ton calme même lorsque les délais sont serrés.  Tu apprécies le travail en équipe.  Tu maîtrises les outils informatiques nécessaires dans un environnement numérique.  Tu parles aussi l’allemand au moins niveau B2 ? C’est un critère indispensable !  Tu parles aussi l’anglais ? C’est un atout !  Ce que nous t'offrons  De nombreuses opportunités et possibilités de faire bouger les choses activement et d'y contribuer.  Une activité variée, exigeante et autonome au sein d'une entreprise à envergure internationale.  Des conditions d'engagement attractives et des perspectives de développement à long terme.  De très bonnes offres pour ton perfectionnement personnel et professionnel.  Un environnement de travail performant et agréable au sein d'une équipe qui vise ensemble le succès.  Une organisation du travail flexible, adaptée à tes besoins.  Envie de nous rejoindre ?  Alors nous nous réjouissons de faire ta connaissance. Postule dès maintenant en ligne. jpid5eeeeb5jm jit0937jm jiy26jm
